.nav-links a::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:-3px;height:1px;background:currentColor;transform:scaleX(0);transform-origin:left;transition:transform .45s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)}
.nav-links a:hover{color:var(--ink)}.nav-links a:hover::after{transform:none}
.nav-right{grid-column:10/span 3;align-items:center;gap:20px;height:28px}
.nav-concierge{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-size:14px;line-height:24px;color:var(--ink-64);white-space:nowrap}
.nav-concierge i{width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:#2fbf71;box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(47,191,113,.18)}
.nav-concierge:hover{color:var(--ink)}
#menu-btn{display:none}
#nav.dark .nav-links a,#nav.dark .nav-concierge{color:rgba(255,255,255,.72)}#nav.dark .nav-links a:hover,#nav.dark .nav-concierge:hover{color:#fff}
@media (max-width:1100px){.nav-concierge{display:none}.nav-links{gap:22px}}
@media (max-width:900px){.nav-links{display:none}#menu-btn{display:flex}.nav-brand{grid-column:1/span 7}.nav-right{grid-column:8/span 5;gap:12px}}
.qbar-wrap{padding:0 var(--pad)}
.qbar{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.2fr 1.2fr 1fr .8fr auto;border-top:1px solid var(--ink-24);border-bottom:1px solid var(--ink-24)}
.field{position:relative;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;gap:4px;padding:14px 16px;min-width:0}
.qbar .field+.field{border-left:1px solid var(--ink-24)}
.qbar .field:first-child{padding-left:0}
.field>span{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:12px;line-height:16px;letter-spacing:.09em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink-64)}
.field input,.field select,.field textarea{width:100%;min-width:0;border:0;padding:0;background:transparent;color:var(--ink);font:300 22px/30px var(--sans);letter-spacing:-.4px;outline:none;-webkit-appearance:none;appearance:none;border-radius:0}
.field textarea{resize:vertical;min-height:60px;font-size:18px;line-height:26px}
.field input::placeholder,.field textarea::placeholder{color:var(--ink-32)}
.field select{cursor:pointer}
.field:focus-within{background:rgba(var(--i),.035)}
.field.bad{box-shadow:inset 0 -2px 0 var(--accent)}
.field.bad>span{color:var(--accent)}
input[type=date]::-webkit-calendar-picker-indicator{opacity:.5;cursor:pointer}
.dark input[type=date]::-webkit-calendar-picker-indicator{filter:invert(1)}
.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:10px;height:56px;padding:0 28px;background:var(--accent);color:#fff;font-size:15px;font-weight:500;white-space:nowrap;transition:background-color .3s ease}
.btn:hover{background:#a00c24}
.btn svg{width:16px;height:16px;transition:transform .5s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)}
.btn:hover svg{transform:translateX(3px)}
.btn.ghost{background:transparent;color:var(--ink);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--ink-32)}
.btn.ghost:hover{box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--ink)}
.qbar .btn{align-self:center;margin-left:16px}
.qbar-note{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;padding:12px 0 0}
.pass .book{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin-top:18px;height:44px;padding:0 16px;background:var(--accent);color:#fff;font-size:14px;font-weight:500}
.pass .book:hover{background:#a00c24}
.pass .book svg{width:16px;height:16px;flex:none}

#book{position:relative;padding:140px var(--pad) 120px}
.book-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(12,1fr);border-top:1px solid var(--ink-24);margin-top:80px;padding-top:40px}
.book-left{grid-column:1/span 4;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:40px}
.steps{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.steps li{display:grid;grid-template-columns:48px 1fr;padding:20px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--ink-24)}
.steps li:last-child{border-bottom:1px solid var(--ink-24)}
.steps b{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:12px;font-weight:400;letter-spacing:.09em;color:var(--ink-48);line-height:28px}
.steps p{font-size:20px;font-weight:300;line-height:28px;letter-spacing:-.4px}
.steps small{display:block;font-size:15px;line-height:22px;color:var(--ink-64);margin-top:4px}
.book-contact{font-size:15px;line-height:24px;color:var(--ink-64)}
.book-contact a{color:var(--ink);font-size:20px;line-height:30px;font-weight:300}
.book-form{grid-column:6/span 7}
.trip{display:flex;gap:8px;margin-bottom:24px}
.trip label{position:relative;cursor:pointer}
.trip input{position:absolute;opacity:0;pointer-events:none}
.trip span{display:flex;align-items:center;height:36px;padding:0 16px;border-radius:24px;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--ink-24);font-size:14px;color:var(--ink-64);transition:all .3s ease}
.trip input:checked+span{background:#fff;color:rgb(38,22,58);box-shadow:none}
.trip input:focus-visible+span{outline:2px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:2px}
.fgrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;border-top:1px solid var(--ink-24)}
.fgrid .field{border-bottom:1px solid var(--ink-24);padding:16px 16px 16px 0}
.fgrid .field:nth-child(even){border-left:1px solid var(--ink-24);padding-left:16px}
.fgrid .field.wide{grid-column:1/-1;border-left:0;padding-left:0}
.fgrid .field.off{opacity:.35;pointer-events:none}
.estimate{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto;align-items:end;gap:24px;padding:28px 0}
.estimate .k{display:block}
.estimate .v{font-size:48px;font-weight:300;line-height:56px;letter-spacing:-2px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.estimate .s{font-size:14px;line-height:20px;color:var(--ink-64);margin-top:6px;max-width:440px}
.form-msg{font-size:14px;line-height:20px;color:#ff8a8a;min-height:20px}
.done{display:none;padding:40px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--ink-24)}
.book-form.sent form{display:none}
.book-form.sent .done{display:block}
.done h3{font-size:48px;font-weight:300;line-height:56px;letter-spacing:-2px;margin:0 0 16px}
.done p{font-size:20px;font-weight:300;line-height:28px;letter-spacing:-.4px;max-width:520px;color:var(--ink-88)}
.done dl{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:16px 24px;margin:32px 0;padding:20px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--ink-24);border-bottom:1px solid var(--ink-24);max-width:620px}
.done dt{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.09em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink-64)}
.done dd{margin:4px 0 0;font-size:20px;font-weight:300;line-height:28px}
.done .row{display:flex;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.faq{grid-column:6/span 7;margin-top:80px}
.faq .label{margin-bottom:16px}

/* ---------- the jet: one canvas, moved between the overlay and the framed stages ---------- */
#jet-layer{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:120;pointer-events:none;opacity:0;transition:opacity 1.2s ease .1s}
.ready #jet-layer{opacity:1}
#hero-shadow{position:absolute;left:0;top:0;opacity:0;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(closest-side,rgba(30,22,24,.42),rgba(30,22,24,.16) 38%,rgba(30,22,24,.05) 70%,rgba(30,22,24,0));filter:blur(4px);will-change:transform}
#gl{position:absolute;left:0;top:0;width:100%;height:100%;pointer-events:none;outline:none}
.stage{position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:var(--panel)}
.stage .poster{position:absolute;left:0;top:0;width:100%;height:100%}
.stage.live #gl{pointer-events:auto;touch-action:pan-y;cursor:grab}
.stage.live #gl.drag{cursor:grabbing}
.stage.live #gl.door{cursor:pointer}
.stage-fade{position:absolute;inset:0;background:#05070a;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;z-index:3}
#xhint{position:absolute;left:50%;bottom:20px;transform:translateX(-50%);z-index:4;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;pointer-events:none;white-space:nowrap}
#xhint span{height:32px;padding:0 14px;display:flex;align-items:center;font-size:14px;color:#fff;background:rgba(10,12,18,.4);border-radius:24px;backdrop-filter:blur(6px)}
#xhint button{pointer-events:auto;height:32px;padding:0 14px;font-size:14px;font-weight:500;color:#fff;background:rgba(10,12,18,.4);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.55);border-radius:24px;backdrop-filter:blur(6px)}
#xhint button:hover{background:rgba(10,12,18,.6)}

/* ---------- dark sections: same tokens, light ink ---------- */
.dark{--i:255,255,255;--ink:#fff;--ink-88:rgba(255,255,255,.88);--ink-64:rgba(255,255,255,.64);--ink-48:rgba(255,255,255,.48);--ink-32:rgba(255,255,255,.32);--ink-24:rgba(255,255,255,.24);--ink-16:rgba(255,255,255,.16);--ink-08:rgba(255,255,255,.08);--night:#170c0d;background:var(--night);color:#fff}
#nav{transition:height .7s cubic-bezier(.32,0,.16,1),background-color .35s ease,color .35s ease}
#nav.dark{background:transparent}
#nav.dark.solid{background:#170c0d}
#nav.dark.open{background:rgba(22,12,13,.78);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(14px);backdrop-filter:blur(14px)}
#nav.dark .wordmark{color:#fff}
#nav.dark .wordmark i{color:#ff5a5f}

/* ---------- the pill that follows the page ---------- */
#pill{position:fixed;left:50%;bottom:20px;z-index:125;transform:translateX(-50%);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;transition:opacity .4s ease,transform .5s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)}
#pill span{height:40px;padding:0 18px;display:flex;align-items:center;border-radius:24px;background:var(--accent);color:#fff;font-size:14px;font-weight:500;box-shadow:0 1px 0 rgba(30,22,24,.08),0 8px 24px rgba(30,22,24,.14)}
#pill i{width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--accent);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;box-shadow:0 1px 0 rgba(30,22,24,.08),0 8px 24px rgba(30,22,24,.14)}
#pill svg{width:16px;height:16px;transition:transform .5s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)}
#pill:hover svg{transform:translate(2px,-2px)}
#pill.off,html.is-loading #pill{opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transform:translate(-50%,12px)}

/* ---------- opening: the window, then the sky ---------- */
#hublot{position:relative;height:calc(100svh + 300vh)}
.hub-sticky{position:sticky;top:0;height:100vh;height:100svh;background:#0f0809}
#film{display:none;position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;z-index:3;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transform-origin:50% 50%}
.film #film{display:block}
.film #hublot{height:calc(100svh + 600vh)}
.hub-ui{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:2;color:#fff;pointer-events:none}
.hub-ui::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(ellipse 62% 70% at 50% 46%,rgba(14,9,10,0) 38%,rgba(14,9,10,.62) 100%)}
.hub-h{position:absolute;font-size:clamp(40px,6.1vw,96px);font-weight:300;line-height:.96;letter-spacing:-.045em;text-shadow:0 2px 30px rgba(14,9,10,.35)}
.hub-h.a{left:var(--pad);top:calc(var(--nav-h) + 4vh)}
.hub-h.b{right:var(--pad);bottom:19vh;text-align:right}
.hub-h .w,.hub-lede .w{display:inline-block;opacity:0;transform:translateY(14px);transition:opacity .7s ease,transform .9s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)}
.hub-in .hub-h .w,.hub-in .hub-lede .w{opacity:1;transform:none}
.hub-lede{position:absolute;left:var(--pad);bottom:28px;max-width:340px;font-size:16px;line-height:22px;letter-spacing:-.2px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.86)}
.hub-statement{position:absolute;z-index:2;left:var(--pad);top:calc(var(--nav-h) + 6vh);max-width:min(1040px,calc(100% - 2 * var(--pad)));font-size:clamp(30px,4vw,60px);font-weight:300;line-height:1.1;letter-spacing:-.04em;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;text-shadow:0 1px 24px rgba(20,60,140,.28)}

/* ---------- hero ---------- */
#hero{position:relative;height:100svh;min-height:560px;padding:0 var(--pad);overflow:hidden;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.hero-card{position:absolute;left:var(--pad);right:var(--pad);top:0;bottom:clamp(104px,calc(5.72vw + 30px),118px)}
.hero-grad{position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--panel) 0%,#fdfdfd 100%);opacity:0;transition:opacity 1.4s ease}
.ready .hero-grad{opacity:1}
#hero{height:calc(100svh + 420svh);overflow:clip;display:block}
.hero-pin{position:sticky;top:0;height:100vh;height:100svh;min-height:560px;margin:0 calc(var(--pad) * -1)}
.hero-vid{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;background:var(--panel);opacity:0;transition:opacity 1.2s ease}
.ready .hero-vid{opacity:1}
#hero-shadow{display:none}
#hero-word{display:none!important}
.hero-title{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:1;margin:0;pointer-events:none;font:400 min(34svh,30vw)/.8 "Anton",Impact,"Arial Narrow",sans-serif;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.004em}
.hero-title span{position:absolute;display:block;white-space:nowrap;opacity:0;transform:translateY(28px);transition:opacity 1.4s ease .25s,transform 1.7s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1) .25s}
.hero-title .ht-b{transition-delay:.45s}
.ready .hero-title span{opacity:1;transform:none}
.ht-a{left:3.5%;top:22%;color:rgba(255,255,255,.06);-webkit-text-stroke:2px rgba(255,255,255,.92);filter:drop-shadow(0 1px 1px rgba(30,22,24,.18))}
.ht-b{right:3.5%;top:54%;color:var(--accent);text-shadow:0 10px 40px rgba(30,22,24,.18)}
@media (max-width:760px){.hero-title{font-size:min(30svh,33vw)}.ht-a{top:16%;-webkit-text-stroke-width:1.5px}.ht-b{top:61%}}
#hero-word text{fill:#fff;fill-opacity:.34;stroke:#fff;stroke-opacity:.7;stroke-width:1.6;paint-order:stroke}
.hero-word{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:150px;width:100%;height:auto;opacity:0;transform:translateY(24px);transition:opacity 1.6s ease .2s,transform 1.8s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1) .2s}
.ready .hero-word{opacity:1;transform:none}
.hero-bottom{position:absolute;left:var(--pad);right:var(--pad);bottom:24px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center}
.hero-lede{font-size:clamp(26px,2.6vw,40px);font-weight:500;line-height:1.1;letter-spacing:-.035em;color:var(--ink)}
.hero-lede .l2{font-weight:300;color:rgba(var(--i),.7)}
.hero-lede .w{display:inline-block;opacity:0;transform:translateY(10px);transition:opacity .6s ease,transform .8s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)}
.ready .hero-lede .w{opacity:1;transform:none}
.scroll-down{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;margin-right:24px;font-size:14px;font-weight:500;line-height:24px}
.scroll-down canvas{width:24px;height:24px}

/* ---------- shared section bits ---------- */
.section-head{position:relative;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start}
.big{font-size:min(240px,16.67vw);font-weight:300;letter-spacing:-.054em;line-height:.9167em;margin-left:-1px;white-space:nowrap}
.badge{flex-shrink:0;height:32px;min-width:44px;padding:0 16px;border:1px solid var(--ink-24);border-radius:24px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:16px;line-height:24px;font-weight:300;color:var(--ink)}
.label{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.label i{display:block;width:4px;height:4px;background:var(--ink-48)}
.para{font-size:32px;font-weight:300;line-height:40px;letter-spacing:-.8px}
.para + .para{margin-top:32px}

/* ---------- intro statement ---------- */
#intro{padding:0 var(--pad)}
.intro-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(12,1fr);border-top:1px solid var(--ink-24);border-bottom:1px solid var(--ink-24)}
.intro-col{grid-column:span 6;border-right:1px solid var(--ink-24);min-height:1088px;padding:80px 0;display:flex;align-items:center}
.statement{font-size:64px;font-weight:300;line-height:72px;letter-spacing:-2.4px;max-width:600px}

/* ---------- aircraft ---------- */
#aircraft{padding:24px var(--pad) 0;height:864px;position:relative}
#aircraft .big{line-height:1.5em}
.gear-body{margin-top:56px;width:calc((100% - 0px) * 5 / 12)}
.gear-body .label{height:24px;margin-bottom:32px}

/* ---------- stats (jet lock) ---------- */
#stats{position:relative;height:calc(100svh + 300vh)}
.stats-sticky{position:sticky;top:0;height:100vh;height:100svh;padding:0 var(--pad);padding-top:66vh}
.stats-arc{position:absolute;left:0;top:0;width:100%;height:100%;pointer-events:none;overflow:visible}
.stats-grid{position:relative;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);border-top:1px solid var(--ink-24);border-bottom:1px solid var(--ink-24);height:250px}
.stat{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;height:248px}
.stat:nth-child(2){border-left:1px solid var(--ink-24);border-right:1px solid var(--ink-24)}
.stat .v{font-size:48px;font-weight:300;line-height:56px;letter-spacing:-2.88px;color:var(--ink-24);transition:color .6s ease;white-space:nowrap}
.stat .k{color:var(--ink-24);letter-spacing:.09em;transition:color .6s ease}
.stat.on .v{color:var(--ink)}
.stat.on .k{color:var(--ink-64)}
.stat .k::before{content:"[\00a0\00a0"}
.stat .k::after{content:"\00a0\00a0]"}
.stats-orb{position:absolute;left:50%;top:0;width:94px;height:94px;margin:-47px 0 0 -47px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid var(--ink-24);background:var(--canvas);z-index:2}
.stats-orb canvas{position:absolute;inset:-1px;width:94px;height:94px}
.stats-tag{position:absolute;left:50%;top:-80px;transform:translateX(-50%);white-space:nowrap;color:var(--ink-64);letter-spacing:.09em}

/* ---------- data sheet: the jet from above ---------- */
#sheet{position:relative;height:calc(100svh + 900vh);background:linear-gradient(180deg,#fdfdfd 0,var(--panel) 12%,var(--panel) 88%,#fff 100%)}
.sheet-sticky{position:sticky;top:0;height:100vh;height:100svh;overflow:hidden}
.sheet-words,.sheet-spec{position:absolute;left:var(--pad);right:var(--pad);top:0;bottom:0;will-change:transform}
.sheet-words .words-row{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:calc(var(--nav-h) + 3vh);bottom:6vh;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between}
.sheet-words .big:nth-child(2){align-self:flex-end}
.sheet-words .cap{position:absolute;left:0;bottom:8vh;font-size:20px;font-weight:300;line-height:24px;letter-spacing:-.4px}
.sheet-spec{top:calc(var(--nav-h) + 24px);bottom:28px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(12,1fr);border-top:1px solid var(--ink-24);transform:translateY(-120%);visibility:hidden}
.ss-left{grid-column:1/span 4;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between;padding-top:20px}
.ss-name small{display:block;font-size:32px;font-weight:400;line-height:36px;letter-spacing:-1px}
.ss-name b{display:block;font-size:min(132px,9.2vw);font-weight:400;line-height:1;letter-spacing:-.05em;margin:18px 0 0 -4px}
.ss-table dl{margin:0}
.ss-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:22px 20px;padding:16px 0 26px;border-top:1px solid var(--ink-24)}
.ss-table dt{font-size:13px;font-weight:500;line-height:16px;letter-spacing:.02em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink-32)}
.ss-table dd{margin:2px 0 0;font-size:14px;font-weight:500;line-height:18px;letter-spacing:.02em;text-transform:uppercase}
.ss-cabin{border-top:1px solid var(--ink-24);padding-top:16px}
.ss-cabin>span{display:block;font-size:13px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.02em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink-32);margin-bottom:14px}
.ss-cabin dl div{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:20px}
.ss-cabin dt{color:var(--ink)}
.ss-cabin dd{margin:0}
.ss-right{grid-column:10/span 3;padding-top:20px}
.ss-title{margin:0;font-size:32px;font-weight:400;line-height:34px;letter-spacing:-1px;max-width:280px}
.ss-desc{margin-top:clamp(48px,14vh,140px);border-top:1px solid var(--ink-24);padding-top:20px}
.ss-desc h4{margin:0 0 32px;font-size:14px;font-weight:500;line-height:18px;letter-spacing:.02em;text-transform:uppercase;max-width:230px}
.ss-desc p{font-size:17px;font-weight:400;line-height:24px;letter-spacing:-.2px;max-width:330px;color:var(--ink-88)}
.plan-layer{position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;clip-path:inset(0 0 100% 0)}
#plan{position:absolute;left:0;top:0;overflow:visible;transform-origin:0 0}

/* ---------- flight ---------- */
#flight{position:relative;background:#fff;padding:200px var(--pad) 64px}
.sol-top{border-top:1px solid var(--ink-24);padding-top:120px;padding-bottom:32px}
.tabs{display:flex;gap:48px;margin-top:80px}
.tab{position:relative;font-size:56px;font-weight:300;line-height:64px;letter-spacing:-1.4px;color:var(--ink-32);transition:color .4s ease}
.tab:hover{color:var(--ink-64)}
.tab.on{color:var(--ink)}
.tab .bar{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:-6px;height:3px;background:var(--ink);transform:scaleX(0);transform-origin:left;transition:transform .7s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)}
.tab.on .bar{transform:scaleX(1)}
.sol-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(12,1fr);border-top:1px solid var(--ink-24);min-height:801px}
.sol-left{grid-column:1/span 5;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between;padding:64px 0 0}
.sol-copy p{font-size:28px;font-weight:300;line-height:32px;letter-spacing:-.8px;max-width:582px}
.sol-copy p + p{margin-top:32px}
.sol-copy{transition:opacity .4s ease}
.specs{width:580px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:24px;margin-bottom:80px}
.spec-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:232px 348px;height:82px}
.spec-cell{border-top:1px solid var(--ink-24);border-bottom:1px solid var(--ink-24);display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;white-space:nowrap;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.spec-cell + .spec-cell{padding-left:8px}
.spec-cell .k{line-height:16px;margin-bottom:6px}
.spec-cell .val{font-size:32px;font-weight:300;line-height:40px;letter-spacing:-.8px;color:var(--ink-88)}
.spec-fill{position:absolute;top:0;bottom:0;left:0;background:rgba(var(--i),.012);transition:width 1s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)}
.spec-fill::after{content:"";position:absolute;right:0;top:0;bottom:0;width:2px;background:var(--ink-48)}
.sol-right{grid-column:7/span 6;position:relative}
.sol-media{width:100%;height:720px}
.chips{display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;gap:8px;margin-top:24px}
.chip{height:32px;padding:0 12px;border:1px solid var(--ink-24);border-radius:24px;display:flex;align-items:center;letter-spacing:.09em}

/* ---------- cabin ---------- */
#cabin{position:relative;background:#fff;border-top:1px solid var(--ink-24);height:calc(100svh + 330vh)}
.caps-sticky{position:sticky;top:var(--nav-h);height:calc(100vh - var(--nav-h));height:calc(100svh - var(--nav-h));display:flex;flex-direction:column;padding:0 var(--pad) 16px;overflow:hidden}
.caps-sticky .section-head{padding-top:24px}
.caps-sticky .badge{position:absolute;right:0;top:24px}
.caps-grid{flex:1;min-height:0;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(12,1fr);border-top:1px solid var(--ink-24);margin-top:24px;position:relative}
.caps-left{grid-column:1/span 3;position:relative;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center}
.caps-list{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:18px}
.caps-list button{text-align:left;font-weight:300;letter-spacing:-1.4px;font-size:37.4px;line-height:46px;color:var(--ink-32);white-space:nowrap;transition:font-size .7s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1),line-height .7s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1),color .5s ease}
.caps-list button.on{font-size:51.84px;line-height:64px;color:var(--ink)}
.caps-corner{position:absolute;bottom:0;color:var(--ink-48)}
.caps-corner.l{left:0}.caps-corner.r{right:24px}
.caps-visual{grid-column:4/span 6}
.caps-right{grid-column:10/span 3;position:relative;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;padding-left:24px}
.caps-stat{position:relative;height:200px}
.caps-item{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);opacity:0;transition:opacity .45s ease}
.caps-item.on{opacity:1;transition-delay:.15s}
.caps-item .v{font-size:48px;font-weight:300;line-height:56px;letter-spacing:-2.8px;margin-bottom:16px}
.caps-item .d{font-size:20px;font-weight:300;line-height:28px;letter-spacing:-.4px;max-width:310px}

/* ---------- on board: what the flight includes ---------- */
#services{position:relative;background:#fff;padding:140px var(--pad) 0}
.svc-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(12,1fr);border-top:1px solid var(--ink-24);padding-top:24px}
.svc-left{grid-column:1/span 5;display:flex;flex-direction:column;min-height:720px}
.svc-left .label{height:24px;margin-bottom:auto}
.acc{border-top:1px solid var(--ink-24)}
.acc:last-child{border-bottom:1px solid var(--ink-24)}
.acc button{width:100%;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:18px 0;text-align:left;font-size:32px;font-weight:300;line-height:40px;letter-spacing:-.8px;color:var(--ink-48);transition:color .4s ease}
.acc button:hover,.acc.on button{color:var(--ink)}
.acc button i{position:relative;width:14px;height:14px;flex:none;margin-right:4px}
.acc button i::before,.acc button i::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;top:6.5px;width:14px;height:1px;background:currentColor;transition:transform .5s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)}
.acc button i::after{transform:rotate(90deg)}
.acc.on button i::after{transform:none}
.acc .body{display:grid;grid-template-rows:0fr;transition:grid-template-rows .6s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)}
.acc.on .body{grid-template-rows:1fr}
.acc .body p{overflow:hidden;font-size:20px;font-weight:300;line-height:28px;letter-spacing:-.4px;max-width:470px;color:var(--ink-88)}
.acc.on .body p{padding-bottom:28px}
.svc-photo{grid-column:7/span 6;position:relative;height:720px;background:var(--panel);overflow:hidden}
.svc-photo canvas{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;opacity:0;transition:opacity .7s ease}
.svc-photo canvas.on{opacity:1}
.strip{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(12,1fr);border-top:1px solid var(--ink-24);margin-top:120px;padding:16px 0 20px;align-items:end}
.strip div:nth-child(1){grid-column:1/span 6}
.strip div:nth-child(2){grid-column:7/span 3}
.strip div:nth-child(3){grid-column:10/span 3;display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;align-items:baseline;gap:16px}
.strip .k{display:block;line-height:16px}
.strip .val{font-size:15px;line-height:20px;font-weight:500}
.strip .clock{font-size:32px;font-weight:300;line-height:32px;letter-spacing:-.8px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}

/* ---------- explore ---------- */
#explore{position:relative;background:#fff;padding:121px var(--pad) 120px}
.soft-body{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(12,1fr);margin-top:80px;min-height:320px;align-items:start}
.soft-body .label{grid-column:1/span 6;height:24px}
.soft-body .copy{grid-column:7/span 5;margin-left:-1px}
.text-link{display:inline-block;margin-top:32px;font-size:16px;font-weight:500;line-height:24px;background:linear-gradient(currentColor,currentColor) 0 100%/100% 1px no-repeat;transition:color .2s}
.text-link:hover{color:var(--ink-64)}
.explore-stage{height:824px;max-height:calc(100svh - var(--nav-h) - 24px)}
.corners{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;padding:12px 0 0}

/* ---------- anywhere: routes within reach ---------- */
#world{position:relative;height:calc(100svh + 260vh)}
.world-sticky{position:sticky;top:0;height:100vh;height:100svh;overflow:hidden}
.world-word{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:-.19em;text-align:center;font-size:22vw;font-weight:300;line-height:1;letter-spacing:-.06em;color:rgba(255,255,255,.045);white-space:nowrap;pointer-events:none}
#globe{position:absolute;left:0;top:0;width:100%;height:100%}
.wheel-row{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:24vh;height:48px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:28px;font-size:28px;font-weight:300;line-height:48px;letter-spacing:-.6px}
.wheel-row .lead{width:30vw;text-align:right}
.wheel-row svg{width:22px;height:22px;flex:none}
.wheel-row .dash{width:44px;height:1px;background:var(--ink-32);flex:none}
.wheel{position:relative;width:30vw;height:48px}
.wheel ul{position:absolute;left:0;top:0;margin:0;padding:0;list-style:none;transition:transform .7s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)}
.wheel li{height:48px;color:transparent;transition:color .5s ease;white-space:nowrap}
.wheel li.far{color:var(--ink-16)}
.wheel li.near{color:var(--ink-32)}
.wheel li.on{color:#fff}
.pass{position:absolute;right:max(var(--pad),7vw);top:50%;width:300px;background:#fbfaf9;color:rgb(38,22,58);padding:20px 20px 18px;will-change:transform}
.pass .top{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start}
.pass .route{font-size:56px;font-weight:300;line-height:56px;letter-spacing:-3px}
.pass .route small{display:block;font-size:14px;line-height:20px;letter-spacing:0;font-weight:400;color:rgba(30,22,24,.64);margin-top:10px}
.pass .bars{width:26px;height:112px;background:repeating-linear-gradient(180deg,rgb(38,22,58) 0 2px,transparent 2px 4px,rgb(38,22,58) 4px 5px,transparent 5px 9px,rgb(38,22,58) 9px 12px,transparent 12px 14px)}
.pass dl{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:14px 12px;margin:56px 0 0;padding-top:14px;border-top:1px solid rgba(30,22,24,.24)}
.pass dt{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px;line-height:14px;letter-spacing:.09em;text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(30,22,24,.64)}
.pass dd{margin:2px 0 0;font-size:20px;line-height:26px;letter-spacing:-.4px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.pass .wordmark{display:block;margin-top:20px;font-size:18px;line-height:20px}
.dark .pass .wordmark{color:#2a1517}
.dark .pass .wordmark i{color:var(--accent)}
.svc-photo canvas{object-fit:cover}

/* ---------- landing + footer ---------- */
#landing{position:relative;height:700px;padding:0 var(--pad)}
#landing .corners{position:absolute;left:var(--pad);right:var(--pad);top:24px;padding:0}
footer{padding:0 var(--pad)}
.foot-main{border-top:1px solid var(--ink-24);height:clamp(440px,calc(100svh - 330px),550px);padding:clamp(40px,6vh,64px) 0;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(12,1fr);grid-template-rows:auto 1fr}
.foot-l{grid-column:1/span 6;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between;grid-row:1/span 2}
.foot-r{grid-column:7/span 6;grid-row:1/span 2;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.foot-big{font-size:24px;font-weight:300;line-height:32px;letter-spacing:-.8px;max-width:470px}
.cta{position:relative;display:inline-flex;align-self:flex-start;align-items:center;justify-content:center;height:48px;padding:0 24px;margin-top:32px;background:#fff;color:rgb(38,22,58);font-size:14px;font-weight:500;overflow:hidden;isolation:isolate}
.cta::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:var(--accent);transform:translateY(101%);transition:transform .5s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1);z-index:-1}
.cta:hover::before{transform:none}
.cta:hover{color:#fff}
.cta{transition:color .3s ease}
.foot-cols{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;margin-top:auto}
.foot-cols h4{margin:0 0 12px;font-size:15px;font-weight:400;line-height:28px;letter-spacing:-.4px;color:var(--ink-64)}
.foot-cols ul{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:9px}
.foot-cols li{font-size:15px;line-height:19px;letter-spacing:-.4px}
.foot-cols li span{color:var(--ink-64)}
.foot-cols a{background:linear-gradient(currentColor,currentColor) 0 100%/0 1px no-repeat;transition:background-size .4s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)}
.foot-cols a:hover{background-size:100% 1px}
.foot-mark{font-size:26px;line-height:26px}
.dark .wordmark{color:#fff}
.dark .wordmark i{color:#ff5a5f}
.foot-legal{border-top:1px solid var(--ink-24);display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;padding:16px 0 20px}
.foot-legal p{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:12px;line-height:16px;letter-spacing:.09em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink-64);max-width:600px}

/* ---------- couture nav ---------- */
#nav.couture{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto 1fr;align-items:center;padding:0 48px;color:var(--ink);background:var(--canvas);transition:background-color .5s ease,color .5s ease,height .7s cubic-bezier(.32,0,.16,1)}
#nav.couture::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0 var(--pad) -70px;background:linear-gradient(rgba(12,6,8,.42),rgba(12,6,8,0));opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:opacity .5s ease}
#nav.couture.on-hero{background:transparent;color:#fff}
#nav.couture.on-hero::before{opacity:1}
#nav.couture>*{position:relative}
.couture .nav-l{display:flex;gap:34px}
.couture .nav-l a,.couture .nav-r{font:500 12px/24px var(--sans);letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:inherit;opacity:.88;transition:opacity .25s}
.couture .nav-l a:hover,.couture .nav-r:hover{opacity:1}
.couture .nav-logo{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:3px;color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
.couture .nav-logo b{font:600 27px/1 "Cormorant Garamond",Georgia,serif;letter-spacing:.34em;margin-right:-.34em;text-transform:uppercase}
.couture .nav-logo small{font:500 8.5px/1 var(--sans);letter-spacing:.52em;margin-right:-.52em;text-transform:uppercase;opacity:.78}

.couture .nav-book{height:38px;padding:0 20px;background:transparent;color:inherit;border:1px solid currentColor;font:500 12px/1 var(--sans);letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;transition:background-color .3s,color .3s,border-color .3s}
.couture .nav-book:hover{background:var(--accent);border-color:var(--accent);color:#fff}

@media (max-width:900px){

  .couture #menu-btn{display:flex}
  #nav.couture.open{background:var(--canvas);color:var(--ink)}
  #nav.couture.open::before{opacity:0}
}

/* ---------- anywhere (figures + globe) ---------- */
.anywhere .aw-globe{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;border:0;pointer-events:none;background:var(--night)}
.anywhere .world-word{z-index:1}
.anywhere .wheel-row,.anywhere .pass,.anywhere .aw-stats{z-index:2}
.aw-stats{position:absolute;left:max(var(--pad),7vw);top:50%;transform:translateY(-30%);display:grid;gap:30px}
.aw-stats div{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px}
.aw-stats .v{font-size:40px;line-height:44px;font-weight:300;letter-spacing:-1.4px;color:#fff;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.aw-stats .k{color:rgba(255,255,255,.56)}
@media (max-width:900px){.aw-stats{display:none}}

/* ---------- story layer ---------- */
h2.big{font-family:"Cormorant Garamond",Georgia,serif;font-weight:500;font-size:min(270px,18.6vw);letter-spacing:-.032em}
h2.big em{font-style:italic;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.anywhere .world-sticky,#book{will-change:clip-path}
#stats.anywhere{background:var(--canvas)}
.anywhere .world-sticky{background:var(--night)}
#aircraft h2.big{font-size:min(200px,13.6vw)}

/* a day aboard */
#day{position:relative;height:calc(100svh + 520vh);background:var(--canvas)}
.day-sticky{position:sticky;top:0;height:100vh;height:100svh;overflow:hidden;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.day-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-end;padding:calc(var(--nav-h) + 4vh) var(--pad) 0}
.day-head h2{margin:0;font:500 min(120px,8.4vw)/.9 "Cormorant Garamond",Georgia,serif;letter-spacing:-.03em;color:var(--ink)}
.day-head h2 em{font-style:italic}
.day-route{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-end;gap:4px;font-size:15px;color:var(--ink-64);text-align:right}
.day-route b{font-weight:500;color:var(--ink)}
.day-line{position:relative;margin:3.4vh var(--pad) 0;height:22px}
.day-line::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:50%;height:1px;background:var(--ink-16)}
.day-line i{position:absolute;left:0;top:50%;height:1px;width:0;background:var(--accent)}
.day-line .dl-a,.day-line .dl-b{position:absolute;top:-22px;font:500 11px/1 var(--mono);letter-spacing:.12em;color:var(--ink-48)}
.day-line .dl-a{left:0}.day-line .dl-b{right:0}
.day-line svg{position:absolute;top:50%;left:0;width:20px;height:20px;margin:-10px 0 0 -10px;fill:var(--accent)}
.day-track{flex:1;display:flex;gap:2.4vw;padding:4.2vh var(--pad) 5vh;will-change:transform}
.day-card{flex:none;width:min(56vw,860px);height:100%;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1.45fr;gap:2.2vw}
.day-txt{display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:flex-end;padding-bottom:1vh}
.day-txt time{font:500 min(104px,7vw)/.9 "Cormorant Garamond",Georgia,serif;letter-spacing:-.03em;color:var(--ink)}
.day-txt small{display:block;margin:14px 0 22px;font:500 11px/1 var(--mono);letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--accent)}
.day-txt h3{margin:0 0 10px;font-size:24px;line-height:30px;font-weight:400;letter-spacing:-.4px;color:var(--ink)}
.day-txt p{margin:0;font-size:15px;line-height:23px;color:var(--ink-64);max-width:300px}
.day-img{position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:var(--panel)}
.day-img img{position:absolute;top:0;left:-8%;width:116%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;will-change:transform}
@media (max-width:900px){
  #day{height:calc(100svh + 600vh)}
  .day-head{flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;gap:10px}
  .day-head h2{font-size:56px}
  .day-route{align-items:flex-start;text-align:left;font-size:13px}
  .day-card{width:84vw;grid-template-columns:1fr;grid-template-rows:1.3fr auto;gap:16px}
  .day-img{order:-1}
  .day-txt{justify-content:flex-start}
  .day-txt time{font-size:52px}
  .day-txt small{margin:10px 0 12px}
  .day-txt h3{font-size:20px;line-height:26px}
  .day-txt p{font-size:14px;line-height:21px}
}

/* ================= flight deck ================= */
:root{--deck:"JetBrains Mono",ui-monospace,Menlo,monospace;--canvas:#f7f6f3;--panel:#ebe8e3;--accent:#c8102e}
body{background:var(--canvas)}
#flight,#cabin,#services,#explore,#day{background:var(--canvas)}
#sheet{background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--canvas) 0,var(--panel) 14%,var(--panel) 86%,var(--canvas) 100%)}
.hero-grad{background:var(--panel)}
.hero-card{left:0!important;right:0!important}
.mono,.k.mono{font-family:var(--deck)}
.day-head h2,h2.big{color:var(--ink)}
.day-txt small{color:var(--accent)}

/* nav */
#nav.deck{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:44px;padding:0 32px;height:var(--nav-h);background:rgba(11,10,10,.78);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(14px);backdrop-filter:blur(14px);border-bottom:1px solid rgba(242,237,232,.12);color:var(--ink);transition:background-color .5s ease,border-color .5s ease}
#nav.deck.on-hero{background:rgba(11,10,10,.18);border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.16)}
#nav.deck.dark{background:rgba(11,10,10,.78)}
.deck .nav-logo{font:600 22px/1 "Cormorant Garamond",Georgia,serif;letter-spacing:.34em;text-transform:uppercase;color:inherit;white-space:nowrap}
.deck .nav-l{display:flex;gap:28px}
.deck .nav-l a{font:500 11.5px/24px var(--deck);letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(242,237,232,.72);transition:color .25s}
.deck .nav-l a:hover{color:#fff}
.deck .nav-right{margin-left:auto;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:22px}
.deck .nav-clock{font:500 11.5px var(--deck);letter-spacing:.14em;color:rgba(242,237,232,.6);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.deck #menu-btn{display:none;background:rgba(242,237,232,.1);color:inherit;border-radius:8px}
#nav.deck.open{height:208px;background:rgba(11,10,10,.94)}

/* boarding-pass buttons */
.tk{position:relative;display:inline-flex!important;align-items:stretch!important;justify-content:flex-start!important;gap:0!important;height:52px;padding:0!important;background:var(--accent)!important;color:#fff!important;border:0!important;border-radius:10px!important;font:500 12px/1 var(--deck)!important;letter-spacing:.14em!important;text-transform:uppercase;box-shadow:none!important;transition:background-color .25s ease,color .25s ease;
  -webkit-mask:radial-gradient(circle 8px at calc(100% - 52px) 0,transparent 97%,#000) top/100% 51% no-repeat,radial-gradient(circle 8px at calc(100% - 52px) 100%,transparent 97%,#000) bottom/100% 51% no-repeat;
  mask:radial-gradient(circle 8px at calc(100% - 52px) 0,transparent 97%,#000) top/100% 51% no-repeat,radial-gradient(circle 8px at calc(100% - 52px) 100%,transparent 97%,#000) bottom/100% 51% no-repeat}
.tk .tk-l{display:flex;align-items:center;flex:1;padding:0 24px;white-space:nowrap}
.tk .tk-r{width:52px;flex:none;display:grid;place-items:center;border-left:2px dashed rgba(255,255,255,.5);transition:border-color .25s}
.tk .tk-r svg{transition:transform .35s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)}
.tk:hover{background:#fff!important;color:var(--accent)!important}.tk:hover .tk-r{border-color:rgba(239,43,64,.45)}.tk:hover .tk-r svg{transform:translateX(3px)}
.deck .nav-book.tk{height:40px;-webkit-mask-size:100% 51%}
.deck .nav-book.tk .tk-l{padding:0 18px}.deck .nav-book.tk .tk-r{width:44px}
.deck .nav-book.tk{-webkit-mask:radial-gradient(circle 7px at calc(100% - 44px) 0,transparent 97%,#000) top/100% 51% no-repeat,radial-gradient(circle 7px at calc(100% - 44px) 100%,transparent 97%,#000) bottom/100% 51% no-repeat;mask:radial-gradient(circle 7px at calc(100% - 44px) 0,transparent 97%,#000) top/100% 51% no-repeat,radial-gradient(circle 7px at calc(100% - 44px) 100%,transparent 97%,#000) bottom/100% 51% no-repeat}
.pass .book.tk{width:100%;margin-top:18px}
#pill.tk-pill span,#pill.tk-pill i{display:none}
#pill.tk-pill .tk{height:48px}
.btn.ghost{border:1px solid rgba(242,237,232,.35);border-radius:10px;background:transparent;color:var(--ink);font-family:var(--deck);letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:12px}
.trip input:checked+span{color:#0b0a0a}

/* hero HUD */
.hud{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:2;pointer-events:none;font:500 11px/1 var(--deck);letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(255,255,255,.86)}
.hud b{display:block;margin-top:8px;font:400 24px/1 var(--deck);letter-spacing:0;color:#fff;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;text-shadow:0 1px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.25)}
.hud .crn{position:absolute;width:24px;height:24px;border:1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,.7)}
.hud .c1{left:24px;top:calc(var(--nav-h) + 20px);border-right:0;border-bottom:0}.hud .c2{right:24px;top:calc(var(--nav-h) + 20px);border-left:0;border-bottom:0}
.hud-tl{position:absolute;left:44px;top:calc(var(--nav-h) + 36px)}
.hud-tr{position:absolute;right:44px;top:calc(var(--nav-h) + 36px);display:flex;gap:44px;text-align:right}
.hud-route{position:absolute;left:44px;width:min(40%,560px);bottom:28px}
.hud-route .ends{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.75)}
.hud-route .ln{position:relative;height:1px;margin:15px 0;background:rgba(255,255,255,.32)}
.hud-route .ln i{position:absolute;left:0;top:0;height:1px;width:0;background:var(--accent)}
.hud-route .ln span{position:absolute;left:0;top:-9px;width:18px;height:18px;margin-left:-9px;color:var(--accent)}
.hud-route .ln svg{width:18px;height:18px;fill:currentColor;display:block}
.hero-title{z-index:1}
.ht-a{top:27%!important}
@media (max-width:760px){.ht-a{top:29%!important}.ht-b{top:60%!important}.anywhere .wheel-row .lead,.anywhere .wheel-row .dash{display:none}.anywhere .wheel-row{gap:14px}}
#nav.deck.open{height:var(--nav-h);-webkit-backdrop-filter:none;backdrop-filter:none;background:#0b0a0a}
#nav.deck.open #menu-btn{height:auto;min-height:28px;transform:none}
#nav.deck #menu-links{position:fixed;left:0;right:0;top:var(--nav-h);display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;gap:2px;padding:14px var(--pad) 22px;background:#0b0a0a;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(242,237,232,.12);opacity:0;transform:translateY(-6px);pointer-events:none;transition:opacity .3s ease,transform .45s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)}
#nav.deck.open #menu-links{opacity:1;transform:none;pointer-events:auto}
#nav.deck #menu-links a{font:500 14px/40px var(--deck);letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#f2ede8;opacity:1;transform:none}
#nav.deck.open .nav-book{opacity:1;pointer-events:auto}

/* split-flap */
.flap{display:flex;gap:3px}
.flap span{position:relative;display:grid;place-items:center;width:30px;height:42px;border-radius:4px;background:#1b1718;color:#f2ede8;font:500 23px/1 var(--deck);box-shadow:inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.04)}
.flap span::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:50%;height:1px;background:rgba(0,0,0,.65)}
.flap span.f{color:rgba(242,237,232,.55)}
.flap.sm span{width:24px;height:34px;font-size:18px}
.anywhere .wheel{position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;overflow:hidden;opacity:0}
.anywhere .wheel-row .lead{width:auto}

/* departures board */
.board{margin:12px 0 100px}
.board-h{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-end;gap:24px;margin-bottom:26px}
.board-h h3{margin:0;font:500 min(76px,6vw)/.95 "Cormorant Garamond",Georgia,serif;letter-spacing:-.02em;color:#fff}
.board-h h3 em{font-style:italic}
.board-h span{font:500 11px var(--deck);letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(242,237,232,.5)}
.brow{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.7fr .6fr .9fr .9fr 120px;align-items:center;gap:12px;width:100%;padding:9px 0;border:0;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(242,237,232,.09);background:transparent;color:inherit;text-align:left;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color .2s}
.brow:not(.bhead):hover,.brow.on{background:rgba(242,237,232,.04)}
.brow.bhead{cursor:default;font:500 10px var(--deck);letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(242,237,232,.45);padding:0 0 10px}
.brow .t{font:400 19px var(--deck);color:#f2ede8;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.brow .go{justify-self:end;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font:500 11px var(--deck);letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(242,237,232,.5);transition:color .2s}
.brow:hover .go,.brow.on .go{color:var(--accent)}

@media (max-width:900px){
  .deck .nav-l,.deck .nav-clock{display:none}
  .deck #menu-btn{display:flex}
  #nav.deck{gap:12px;padding:0 var(--pad)}
  .deck .nav-logo{font-size:18px;letter-spacing:.26em}
  .hud-tr .hdg{display:none}.hud-tr{gap:22px;right:20px}.hud-tl{left:20px}
  .hud b{font-size:17px}
  .hud .c1{left:10px}.hud .c2{right:10px}
  .hud-route{left:20px;right:20px;width:auto;bottom:18px}
  .hud-route .ends span{font-size:9px}
  .flap span{width:22px;height:32px;font-size:17px}
  .brow{grid-template-columns:1.6fr .6fr .9fr;gap:8px}.brow > :nth-child(4),.brow > :nth-child(5){display:none}
  .brow .t{font-size:14px}.flap.sm span{width:17px;height:26px;font-size:14px}
  .board-h{flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start}.board-h h3{font-size:44px}
}

/* ================= clean ================= */
.dark{--night:#0a0a0a}
#stats.anywhere,.anywhere .world-sticky{background:#0a0a0a}
.anywhere .aw-globe{background:#0a0a0a}

/* type: one family, light display */
h2.big,.day-head h2,.board-h h3,.day-txt time{font-family:var(--sans)!important;font-weight:300!important;font-style:normal!important}
h2.big{font-size:min(220px,15vw);letter-spacing:-.055em;line-height:.9}
#aircraft h2.big{font-size:min(180px,12.4vw)}
.day-head h2{font-size:min(96px,7vw);letter-spacing:-.05em;line-height:.95}
.day-txt time{font-size:min(84px,5.8vw);letter-spacing:-.05em;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.board-h h3{font-size:min(64px,5vw);letter-spacing:-.045em;line-height:1}
.day-txt h3{font-weight:400;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.em{font-style:normal}

/* hero title: light, no outline */
.hero-title{font-family:var(--sans)!important;font-weight:300!important;font-size:min(27svh,22vw)!important;letter-spacing:-.06em!important;line-height:.85!important}
.ht-a{color:#fff!important;-webkit-text-stroke:0!important;filter:none!important;text-shadow:0 2px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.18)}
.ht-b{color:#fff!important;text-shadow:0 2px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.18)!important}

/* nav */
#nav.deck{background:rgba(247,246,243,.84);border-bottom:1px solid rgba(30,22,24,.08);color:#1e1618}
#nav.deck.on-hero{background:transparent;border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.14);color:#fff}
#nav.deck.dark{background:rgba(10,10,10,.82);border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.1);color:#fff}
.deck .nav-logo{font:500 14px/1 var(--sans);letter-spacing:.34em}
.deck .nav-l a{font:400 14px/24px var(--sans);letter-spacing:-.005em;text-transform:none;color:rgba(30,22,24,.6)}
.deck .nav-l a:hover{color:#1e1618}
#nav.deck.on-hero .nav-l a,#nav.deck.dark .nav-l a{color:rgba(255,255,255,.72)}
#nav.deck.on-hero .nav-l a:hover,#nav.deck.dark .nav-l a:hover{color:#fff}
.deck .nav-clock{font-size:11px;color:rgba(30,22,24,.5)}
#nav.deck.on-hero .nav-clock,#nav.deck.dark .nav-clock{color:rgba(255,255,255,.6)}
.deck #menu-btn{background:rgba(30,22,24,.06)}
#nav.deck.on-hero #menu-btn,#nav.deck.dark #menu-btn{background:rgba(255,255,255,.12)}
#nav.deck.open{background:#f7f6f3;color:#1e1618}
#nav.deck #menu-links{background:#f7f6f3;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(30,22,24,.08)}
#nav.deck #menu-links a{font:400 22px/48px var(--sans);letter-spacing:-.02em;text-transform:none;color:#1e1618}

/* ticket buttons: invert to ink on light, to white on black */
.tk{font-weight:500!important}
.tk:hover{background:#1e1618!important;color:#fff!important}.tk:hover .tk-r{border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.4)}
.dark .tk:hover,#nav.deck.on-hero .tk:hover,#nav.deck.dark .tk:hover{background:#fff!important;color:var(--accent)!important}
.dark .tk:hover .tk-r,#nav.deck.on-hero .tk:hover .tk-r{border-color:rgba(200,16,46,.4)}
.btn.ghost{border-color:rgba(var(--i),.3);font-family:var(--sans);letter-spacing:0;text-transform:none;font-size:14px}

.hero-lede .l2{display:block;margin-top:8px;font-size:clamp(17px,1.4vw,21px);line-height:1.35;letter-spacing:-.01em}
.hero-lede br{display:none}
@media (max-width:760px){.hero-lede .l2{font-size:15px;line-height:21px;margin-top:6px}.hero-bottom{bottom:36px}}
/* labels */
.day-line .dl-a,.day-line .dl-b,.day-txt small{font-family:var(--deck)}
.flap span{background:#1f1f1f;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.05)}
@media (max-width:900px){
  .hero-title{font-size:min(20svh,27vw)!important}.ht-a{top:21%!important}.ht-b{top:63%!important}
  h2.big{font-size:17vw}#aircraft h2.big{font-size:14vw}
  .day-head h2{font-size:48px}.day-txt time{font-size:46px}.board-h h3{font-size:40px}
}

/* ---------- cabin plan -> 3D ---------- */
.p3{position:fixed;inset:0;pointer-events:none;opacity:0;z-index:125}
.p3-head{position:absolute;left:var(--pad);top:calc(var(--nav-h) + 26px);max-width:520px}
.p3-eye{margin:0 0 14px;font:500 11px/1 var(--deck,var(--mono));letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink-48)}
.p3-head h3{margin:0;font:300 min(56px,4.2vw)/1 var(--sans);letter-spacing:-.045em;color:var(--ink)}
.p3-cap{margin:16px 0 0;max-width:340px;font-size:15px;line-height:22px;color:var(--ink-64)}
.p3-svg{position:absolute;left:0;top:0;width:100%;height:100%;overflow:visible}
.p3-svg line{stroke:rgba(30,22,24,.5);stroke-width:1}
.p3-svg .dim line{stroke:rgba(30,22,24,.45)}
.p3-svg circle{fill:var(--accent)}
.p3-svg text{font:500 11px var(--deck,var(--mono));letter-spacing:.12em;fill:rgba(30,22,24,.6)}
.p3-lab{position:absolute;left:0;top:0;display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:10px;white-space:nowrap;will-change:transform}
.p3-lab b{font:500 11px/1 var(--deck,var(--mono));letter-spacing:.1em;color:var(--accent)}
.p3-lab span{font-size:15px;line-height:1;color:var(--ink)}
.p3-lab small{font-size:13px;color:var(--ink-48)}
@media (max-width:900px){
  .p3-head{max-width:none;right:var(--pad)}
  .p3-head{top:calc(var(--nav-h) + 16px)}.p3-eye{margin-bottom:8px}.p3-head h3{font-size:24px}.p3-head h3 br{display:none}.p3-cap{display:none}
  .p3-lab span{font-size:13px}.p3-lab small{display:none}
}

/* ================= v10 ================= */
#flight,#cabin,#day,#hublot,#explore,#services{display:none!important}
.badge{display:none!important}

/* hero: full-height film, captions on the edge */
#hero .hero-card{bottom:0!important}
#hero .hero-bottom{position:absolute!important;width:1px;height:1px;overflow:hidden;clip:rect(0 0 0 0);white-space:nowrap}
.hero-caps{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;height:46%;z-index:2;pointer-events:none;
  background:linear-gradient(0deg,rgba(10,8,9,.52) 0%,rgba(10,8,9,.24) 45%,rgba(10,8,9,0) 100%);opacity:var(--scrim,0)}
.hc{position:absolute;left:var(--pad);bottom:clamp(28px,5vh,56px);margin:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px;color:#fff;
  opacity:var(--o,0);transform:translateX(var(--x,-60px));clip-path:inset(0 var(--cr,100%) 0 var(--cl,0));will-change:transform,clip-path,opacity}
.hc-i{font:500 11px/1 var(--deck,var(--mono));letter-spacing:.14em;color:rgba(255,255,255,.7)}
.hc-t{font:300 clamp(40px,4.8vw,78px)/.98 var(--sans);letter-spacing:-.05em;text-shadow:0 2px 28px rgba(0,0,0,.18)}
@media (max-width:900px){.hc{bottom:40px}.hc-t{font-size:40px}.hero-caps{height:55%}}

/* ownership and trust */
#own{position:relative;background:var(--canvas);padding:140px var(--pad) 120px}
.own-eye{margin:0;font:500 11px/1 var(--deck,var(--mono));letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink-48)}
.own-top{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(12,1fr);align-items:end;margin-bottom:64px}
.own-top .own-eye{grid-column:1/span 3;padding-bottom:12px}
.own-h{grid-column:4/span 9;margin:0;font:300 min(96px,6.6vw)/.98 var(--sans);letter-spacing:-.05em;color:var(--ink)}
.pl-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);border-top:1px solid var(--ink-16)}
.pl{position:relative;display:flex;flex-direction:column;padding:28px 28px 32px 0;min-height:440px}
.pl + .pl{padding-left:28px;border-left:1px solid var(--ink-16)}
.pl-k{margin:0 0 40px;font:500 11px/1 var(--deck,var(--mono));letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink-48)}
.pl h3{margin:0;font:300 clamp(28px,2.4vw,38px)/1.05 var(--sans);letter-spacing:-.04em;color:var(--ink)}
.pl-price{margin:28px 0 0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px}
.pl-price b{font:400 clamp(26px,2vw,32px)/1 var(--sans);letter-spacing:-.03em;color:var(--accent)}

/* ================= v36: header, logo, hero type, quote bar, white footer ================= */

.rw-g a,.rw-g span{color:inherit}

    box-shadow:0 1px 0 rgba(30,22,24,.1)}
  #nav.deck.rw.on-hero{background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(6,20,48,.28),rgba(6,20,48,0))!important;box-shadow:0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.22)}
  #nav.deck.rw.dark{box-shadow:0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.1)}
  #nav.deck.rw > *{display:flex!important;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center}
  #nav.deck.rw .nav-logo{flex-direction:row!important;padding-right:32px}
  #nav.deck.rw .rw-g{padding:0 28px;border-left:1px solid rgba(30,22,24,.12)}
  #nav.deck.rw.on-hero .rw-g,#nav.deck.rw.dark .rw-g{border-left-color:rgba(255,255,255,.2)}
  #nav.deck.rw .nav-right{flex-direction:row!important;align-items:center!important;align-self:stretch!important;height:auto!important;margin:0!important;justify-content:flex-end;padding-left:28px;border-left:1px solid rgba(30,22,24,.12)}
  #nav.deck.rw.on-hero .nav-right,#nav.deck.rw.dark .nav-right{border-left-color:rgba(255,255,255,.2)}
  #nav.deck.rw .nav-l{justify-self:auto;display:flex!important;gap:22px!important}
  #nav.deck.rw .nav-l a{color:inherit!important;opacity:.72;font:400 14px/20px var(--sans)!important;transition:opacity .25s}
  #nav.deck.rw .nav-l a:hover,#nav.deck.rw .nav-l a.on{opacity:1}
  #nav.deck.rw .nav-l a::after{left:-9px!important;bottom:8px!important;margin:0!important}
  #nav.deck.rw .rw-call a{background:linear-gradient(currentColor,currentColor) 0 100%/0 1px no-repeat;transition:background-size .4s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)}
  #nav.deck.rw .rw-call a:hover{background-size:100% 1px}
  #nav.deck.rw #menu-btn,#nav.deck.rw #menu-links{display:none!important}
}
@media (min-width:901px) and (max-width:1240px){ #nav.deck.rw .rw-base{display:none!important} #nav.deck.rw{grid-template-columns:auto minmax(0,1.6fr) minmax(0,1fr) auto!important} }
@media (max-width:900px){
  .rw-g{display:none}
  .rw-tile{width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:8px}.rw-wing{width:19px;height:19px}
  #nav.rw .nav-logo b{font-size:19px}
}

/* hero type */
.hero-title.rwx{position:absolute;inset:auto 0 0 0;top:auto;padding:0 var(--pad);pointer-events:none;font:inherit!important;letter-spacing:0!important;line-height:normal!important;text-transform:none!important;color:#fff}
.rwx-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto 1fr;align-items:end;gap:32px;padding:0 0 20px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.4);
  opacity:0;transform:translateY(14px);transition:opacity 1.2s ease .5s,transform 1.4s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1) .5s}
.rwx-sub{margin:0;font:300 19px/1.32 var(--sans);letter-spacing:-.012em;color:rgba(255,255,255,.86);text-shadow:0 1px 18px rgba(6,24,58,.35)}
.rwx-sub b{font-weight:500;color:#fff}
.rwx-facts{display:flex;gap:28px;margin:0;padding:0;list-style:none;font:500 10.5px/1 var(--deck,var(--mono));letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(255,255,255,.85);text-shadow:0 1px 14px rgba(6,24,58,.4)}
.rwx-facts b{font:400 15px/1 var(--sans);letter-spacing:-.01em;text-transform:none;color:#fff;margin-right:6px}
.rwx-cue{justify-self:end;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;margin:0;font:500 10.5px/1 var(--deck,var(--mono));letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(255,255,255,.8)}
.rwx-cue i{position:relative;width:1px;height:34px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.3);overflow:hidden}
.rwx-cue i::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;top:-40%;width:1px;height:40%;background:#fff;animation:rwxcue 2.2s cubic-bezier(.65,0,.35,1) infinite}
@keyframes rwxcue{to{top:100%}}
.rwx-word{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;margin:0;padding:2.2vw 0 0;font:400 18.4vw/.74 var(--sans);letter-spacing:-.055em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#fff;white-space:nowrap;
  filter:drop-shadow(0 4px 30px rgba(20,45,90,.28))}
.rwx-word b{display:block;font-weight:400;opacity:0;transform:translateY(30%);clip-path:inset(0 0 100% 0);transition:opacity 1s ease .2s,transform 1.6s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1) .2s,clip-path 1.6s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1) .2s}
.rwx-word b+b{transition-delay:.34s}
.rwx-word{padding-bottom:calc(var(--pad) * .9)}
.ready .rwx-row{opacity:1;transform:none}
.ready .rwx-word b{opacity:1;transform:none;clip-path:inset(-10% -5% -10% -5%)}
@media (max-width:900px){
  .rwx-row{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:14px;padding-bottom:16px}
  .rwx-facts,.rwx-cue{display:none}
  .rwx-sub{font-size:16px}
  .rwx-word{font-size:20.5vw;padding-top:14px;padding-bottom:48px}
}

/* quote bar */
.qbar-wrap{padding:36px var(--pad) 0!important}
.qbar.qb{display:grid!important;grid-template-columns:1.05fr 1fr 1.25fr 1fr .9fr auto!important;align-items:stretch;gap:0;border:1px solid rgba(30,22,24,.09)!important;border-radius:20px;background:#fff;padding:10px;
  box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(30,22,24,.04),0 24px 60px -24px rgba(30,22,24,.18)}
.qb-head{display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;gap:6px;padding:0 22px 0 18px}
.qb-t{margin:0;font:400 26px/1 var(--sans);letter-spacing:-.035em;color:var(--ink)}
.qb-s{margin:0;font:400 13px/1.35 var(--sans);color:rgba(30,22,24,.52)}
.qb-f{position:relative;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;gap:5px;min-width:0;padding:14px 22px;border-radius:14px;border-left:1px solid rgba(30,22,24,.08);cursor:text;transition:background-color .25s}
.qb-head+.qb-f{border-left-color:rgba(30,22,24,.08)}
.qb-f:hover,.qb-f:focus-within{background:#f6f4f1}
.qb-f:hover+.qb-f,.qb-f:focus-within+.qb-f,.qb-f:hover,.qb-f:focus-within{border-left-color:transparent}
.qb-l{font:500 12px/1 var(--sans);letter-spacing:.01em;color:rgba(30,22,24,.5)}
.qb .qb-v{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;width:100%;min-width:0;margin:0;padding:0;border:0;background:none;outline:0;font:400 21px/28px var(--sans);letter-spacing:-.02em;color:var(--ink);text-overflow:ellipsis}
.qb input.qb-v::placeholder{color:rgba(30,22,24,.32)}
.qb-h{font:400 12px/1.2 var(--sans);color:rgba(30,22,24,.42);white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.qb-from{cursor:default}
.qb-dot{flex:none;width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--accent);box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(200,16,46,.12)}
.qb-date{cursor:pointer}
.qb-dv{color:rgba(30,22,24,.32)!important}.qb-dv.set{color:var(--ink)!important}
.qb-date input[type=date]{position:absolute;left:22px;bottom:12px;width:1px;height:1px;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;border:0;padding:0}
.qb-pax{cursor:default}
.qb-step{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px}
.qb-step .qb-v{width:auto!important;min-width:2ch;justify-content:center;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.qb-step button{flex:none;display:grid;place-items:center;width:30px;height:30px;padding:0;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid rgba(30,22,24,.14);background:#fff;color:var(--ink);font:300 18px/1 var(--sans);cursor:pointer;transition:border-color .2s,background-color .2s}
.qb-step button:hover{border-color:rgba(30,22,24,.4)}
.qb-step button:disabled{opacity:.35;cursor:default}
.qb-go{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:22px;margin-left:8px;padding:0 12px 0 28px;min-width:230px;border:0;border-radius:14px;background:var(--accent);color:#fff;font:500 16px/1 var(--sans);letter-spacing:-.01em;cursor:pointer;
  box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.18),0 10px 28px -10px rgba(170,12,34,.6);transition:filter .3s}
.qb-go i{display:grid;place-items:center;width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:10px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.16)}
.qb-go svg{width:20px;height:20px;transition:transform .45s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)}
.qb-go:hover{filter:brightness(1.06)}.qb-go:hover svg{transform:translateX(3px)}
.qb-note{display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;min-height:20px;padding:12px 6px 0!important;margin-bottom:28px;font:400 13px/1 var(--sans);color:rgba(30,22,24,.5)}
@media (max-width:1240px){ .qbar.qb{grid-template-columns:1fr 1.2fr 1fr .9fr auto!important} .qb-head{display:none} .qb-head+.qb-f{border-left-color:transparent} }
@media (max-width:900px){
  .qbar-wrap{padding-top:20px!important}
  .qbar.qb{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr!important;padding:8px;border-radius:18px}
  .qb-f{padding:12px 14px;border-left:0!important;border-top:1px solid rgba(30,22,24,.08);border-radius:0}
  .qb-from,.qb-to{grid-column:1/-1}.qb-from{border-top:0}
  .qb-date{border-right:1px solid rgba(30,22,24,.08)}
  .qb .qb-v{font-size:19px}
  .qb-go{grid-column:1/-1;margin:8px 0 0;height:58px;min-width:0}

#landing::after{height:52%!important;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(255,255,255,0),rgba(255,255,255,.5) 55%,#fff)!important}

/* ================= v37: quote bar as tiles ================= */
.qbar-wrap{position:relative;z-index:40}
.qbar.rq{position:relative;display:grid!important;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,2.3fr) minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,.9fr) auto!important;align-items:center;gap:10px;
  padding:10px;border:1px solid rgba(30,22,24,.07)!important;border-radius:22px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.86);
  box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(30,22,24,.04),0 30px 70px -30px rgba(30,22,24,.22);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(14px);backdrop-filter:blur(14px)}
.rq-route{position:relative;display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,.86fr) minmax(0,1.14fr);gap:10px;min-width:0}
.rq-t{position:relative;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;min-width:0;height:72px;margin:0;padding:0 16px 0 18px;border:1px solid rgba(30,22,24,.09);border-radius:15px;background:#fff;color:var(--ink);font:inherit;text-align:left;cursor:pointer;
  box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(30,22,24,.04);transition:border-color .25s,box-shadow .25s,background-color .25s}
.rq-t:hover{border-color:rgba(30,22,24,.2)}
.rq-t.act,.rq-t:focus-within,.rq-t:focus-visible{outline:0;border-color:rgba(200,16,46,.55);box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(200,16,46,.09)}
.rq-from{cursor:default;background:#faf8f5}.rq-from:hover{border-color:rgba(30,22,24,.09)}
.rq-i{flex:none;width:22px;height:22px;fill:none;stroke:rgba(30,22,24,.5);stroke-width:1.5;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}
.rq-from .rq-i{stroke:var(--accent)}
.rq-c{flex:none;width:18px;height:18px;margin-left:auto;fill:none;stroke:rgba(30,22,24,.45);stroke-width:1.6;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;transition:transform .3s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)}
.rq-t.act .rq-c{transform:rotate(180deg)}
.rq-tx{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:5px;min-width:0;flex:1}
.rq-l{font:500 12px/1 var(--sans);letter-spacing:.005em;color:rgba(30,22,24,.5);cursor:inherit}
.rq .rq-v{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;width:100%;min-width:0;margin:0;padding:0;border:0;background:none;outline:0;font:500 17px/22px var(--sans);letter-spacing:-.015em;color:var(--ink);white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.rq input.rq-v::placeholder,.rq .rq-v.rq-ph{color:rgba(30,22,24,.36);font-weight:400}
.rq-code{flex:none;font:500 10.5px/1 var(--deck,var(--mono));letter-spacing:.08em;font-style:normal;padding:4px 6px;border-radius:5px;background:rgba(30,22,24,.06);color:rgba(30,22,24,.62)}
.rq-link{position:absolute;left:calc(43% - 1px);top:50%;z-index:2;display:grid;place-items:center;width:34px;height:34px;margin:-17px 0 0 -17px;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;border:1px solid rgba(30,22,24,.1);box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(30,22,24,.08)}
.rq-link svg{width:15px;height:15px;fill:var(--accent);transform:rotate(45deg)}
.qbar.rq .tk{justify-self:end;margin-left:4px}
/* panels */
.rq-pop{position:absolute;z-index:5;left:0;top:0;opacity:0;visibility:hidden;transform:translateY(-6px) scale(.985);transform-origin:20% 0;
  border:1px solid rgba(30,22,24,.08);border-radius:18px;background:#fff;box-shadow:0 2px 6px rgba(30,22,24,.05),0 30px 60px -20px rgba(30,22,24,.28);
  transition:opacity .2s ease,transform .3s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1),visibility 0s .3s}
.rq-pop.on{opacity:1;visibility:visible;transform:none;transition:opacity .2s ease,transform .3s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)}
.rq-dest{width:360px;padding:8px}
.rq-ph-h{margin:8px 12px 6px;font:500 10.5px/1 var(--deck,var(--mono));letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(30,22,24,.42)}
.rq-o{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;width:100%;padding:11px 12px;border:0;border-radius:11px;background:none;font:400 15px/1.2 var(--sans);color:var(--ink);text-align:left;cursor:pointer}
.rq-o.hi,.rq-o:hover{background:#f6f3ef}
.rq-o-c{flex:1;min-width:0;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
.rq-o-h{font:400 13px/1 var(--sans);color:rgba(30,22,24,.5);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.rq-none{margin:10px 12px;font:400 14px/1.4 var(--sans);color:rgba(30,22,24,.6)}
.rq-cal{width:316px;padding:16px}
.rq-cal-h{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:10px}
.rq-cal-h b{font:500 15px/1 var(--sans);letter-spacing:-.01em}
.rq-nav{display:grid;place-items:center;width:32px;height:32px;padding:0;border:1px solid rgba(30,22,24,.1);border-radius:50%;background:#fff;cursor:pointer}
.rq-nav svg{width:16px;height:16px;fill:none;stroke:var(--ink);stroke-width:1.6;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}
.rq-nav:disabled{opacity:.3;cursor:default}
.rq-wd,.rq-days{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(7,1fr);gap:2px 0}
.rq-wd span{padding:6px 0;text-align:center;font:500 11px/1 var(--sans);color:rgba(30,22,24,.4)}
.rq-d{position:relative;height:38px;padding:0;border:0;background:none;font:400 14px/1 var(--sans);color:var(--ink);cursor:pointer;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.rq-d::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:2px 3px;border-radius:10px;z-index:-1;transition:background-color .15s}
.rq-days{position:relative;z-index:0}
.rq-d:hover::before{background:#f3efea}
.rq-d.off{color:rgba(30,22,24,.22);cursor:default}.rq-d.off:hover::before{background:none}
.rq-d.now{font-weight:600}
.rq-d.in{background:rgba(200,16,46,.07)}
.rq-d.sel{color:#fff;font-weight:500}.rq-d.sel::before{background:var(--accent)}
.rq-cal-f{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:12px;margin-top:12px;padding-top:12px;border-top:1px solid rgba(30,22,24,.08);font:400 12.5px/1.3 var(--sans);color:rgba(30,22,24,.55)}
.rq-oneway{padding:7px 12px;border:1px solid rgba(30,22,24,.14);border-radius:999px;background:#fff;font:500 12.5px/1 var(--sans);color:var(--ink);cursor:pointer}
.rq-pp{width:320px;padding:18px}
.rq-pp-r{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px}
.rq-pp-r b{display:block;font:500 15px/1.2 var(--sans)}.rq-pp-r small{display:block;margin-top:4px;font:400 12.5px/1.3 var(--sans);color:rgba(30,22,24,.5)}
.rq-step{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}
.rq-step button{display:grid;place-items:center;width:34px;height:34px;padding:0;border:1px solid rgba(30,22,24,.16);border-radius:50%;background:#fff;font:300 19px/1 var(--sans);color:var(--ink);cursor:pointer}
.rq-step button:hover{border-color:rgba(30,22,24,.45)}.rq-step button:disabled{opacity:.3;cursor:default}
.rq-step output{min-width:2ch;text-align:center;font:500 17px/1 var(--sans);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.rq-pp-n{margin:14px 0 0;padding-top:12px;border-top:1px solid rgba(30,22,24,.08);font:400 12.5px/1.4 var(--sans);color:rgba(30,22,24,.55)}
@media (max-width:1240px){ .qbar.rq{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr)) auto!important} .rq-route{grid-column:1/-1} }
@media (max-width:900px){
  .qbar.rq{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr!important;gap:8px;padding:8px;border-radius:20px}
  .rq-route{grid-column:1/-1;grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:8px}
  .rq-link{left:auto;right:18px;margin:-17px 0 0}
  .rq-t{height:64px;padding:0 14px;gap:12px}
  .rq-pax{grid-column:1/-1}
  .rq-dep .rq-c,.rq-ret .rq-c{display:none}
  .rq-dep,.rq-ret{padding:0 12px;gap:10px}
  .rq .rq-v{font-size:16px}
  .qbar.rq .tk{grid-column:1/-1;justify-self:stretch;margin:4px 0 0;width:100%}
  .rq-dest,.rq-cal,.rq-pp{width:min(340px,calc(100vw - 2 * var(--pad) - 16px))}
}

<script>
(() => {
  const wrap = document.getElementById('tp-wrap'), loader = document.getElementById('loader');
  if (!wrap) return;
  const W = 600, H = 228, P = 452;
  const fit = () => { wrap.style.scale = Math.min(1, (innerWidth - 32) / W); };
  fit(); addEventListener('resize', fit);
  // the count drives the perforation; both faces show the same number
  const cnt = document.getElementById('loader-count'), twin = wrap.querySelector('.tp-b .tp-count');
  new MutationObserver(() => { const v = +cnt.textContent || 0; twin.textContent = v; wrap.style.setProperty('--p', v / 100); })
    .observe(cnt, { childList: true, characterData: true, subtree: true });
  // one jagged edge shared by both halves, so they fit
  const edge = []; let x = 0;
  for (let y = 0; y <= H; y += 5 + Math.random() * 4) { x = Math.max(-4, Math.min(4, x + (Math.random() - .5) * 5)); edge.push([P + x, y]); }
  edge.push([P + x, H]);
  const pt = ([a, b]) => a.toFixed(1) + 'px ' + b.toFixed(1) + 'px';
  const left = ['0 0', ...edge.map(pt), '0 ' + H + 'px'], right = [...edge.map(pt), W + 'px ' + H + 'px', W + 'px 0'];
  const t0 = performance.now();
  const pre = () => { if (window.__rwPreStop) return;
    const v = Math.floor(90 * (1 - Math.exp(-(performance.now() - t0) / 1400)));
    if (String(v) !== cnt.textContent) cnt.textContent = v; window.__rwPre = v; requestAnimationFrame(pre); };
  requestAnimationFrame(pre);
  let done = false;
  // ?nointro (and anything else that calls start() directly): no tear, just go
  new MutationObserver(() => { if (!done && loader.classList.contains('out') && !loader.classList.contains('gone')) loader.classList.add('gone'); })
    .observe(loader, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['class'] });
  window.__rwTear = (start) => {
    if (done) return; done = true;
    const reduce = matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
    const open = () => { loader.classList.add('split'); start(); setTimeout(() => loader.classList.add('gone'), 1000); };
    if (reduce) { loader.classList.add('gone'); start(); return; }
    setTimeout(() => wrap.classList.add('tug'), 90);                // a beat on 100, then the pull
    setTimeout(() => {
      wrap.querySelector('.tp-a .tp-face').style.clipPath = 'polygon(' + left.join(',') + ')';
      wrap.querySelector('.tp-b .tp-face').style.clipPath = 'polygon(' + right.join(',') + ')';
      wrap.classList.add('torn');
      requestAnimationFrame(() => requestAnimationFrame(() => { wrap.classList.add('fly'); setTimeout(open, 60); }));
    }, 330);
  };
})();
</script>

// Aircraft frame: +X nose, +Y up, +Z starboard. Origin on the fuselage centreline, mid-length.
const CY = 2.30, LEN = 30.4, NOSE = 15.2, RF = 1.30;
const XRAY_OFF = -17.5;

const SYS = {
  structure: { name: 'Structure', hex: '#7db4ff' },
  fuel: { name: 'Fuel', hex: '#ffab45' },
  hydraulics: { name: 'Hydraulics', hex: '#4fe6a0' },
  electrics: { name: 'Electrics', hex: '#a88cff' },

// uniforms shared by every material on the jet
const U = {

/* ───────────────────────── geometry helpers ───────────────────────── */
// Parametric grid. fn(u, v, out) writes a position and may return [u, v] texture coordinates.
function grid(nu, nv, fn, { wrapV = false, wrapU = false, flip = false } = {}) {
  const n = (nu + 1) * (nv + 1), pos = new Float32Array(n * 3), uv = new Float32Array(n * 2), idx = [];
  const p = V3(); let k = 0, q = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i <= nu; i++) for (let j = 0; j <= nv; j++) {
    const u = i / nu, v = j / nv, r = fn(u, v, p);
    pos[k++] = p.x; pos[k++] = p.y; pos[k++] = p.z; uv[q++] = r ? r[0] : u; uv[q++] = r ? r[1] : v;
  }
  for (let i = 0; i < nu; i++) for (let j = 0; j < nv; j++) {
    const a = i * (nv + 1) + j, b = a + 1, c = a + nv + 1, d = c + 1;

  const weld = (a, b) => {
    const x = nr.getX(a) + nr.getX(b), y = nr.getY(a) + nr.getY(b), z = nr.getZ(a) + nr.getZ(b), l = Math.hypot(x, y, z) || 1;

}
// Flat fan cap over a planar loop of points, facing `dir`.
function cap(pts, dir) {
  const c = V3(); pts.forEach(p => c.add(p)); c.multiplyScalar(1 / pts.length);

  const fl = nrm.dot(dir) < 0; nrm.normalize(); if (fl) nrm.negate();
  const pos = [], nor = [], uv = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < pts.length; i++) {
    const a = pts[i], b = pts[(i + 1) % pts.length], tri = fl ? [c, b, a] : [c, a, b];
    for (const t of tri) { pos.push(t.x, t.y, t.z); nor.push(nrm.x, nrm.y, nrm.z); uv.push(0.5, 0.5); }
  }
  const g = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
  g.setAttribute('position', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(pos, 3));
  g.setAttribute('normal', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(nor, 3));
  g.setAttribute('uv', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(uv, 2));

const merge = list => mergeGeometries(list.map(g => g.index ? g.toNonIndexed() : g), false);
// Surface of revolution about the X axis from a profile of [x, r] points.
function lathe(profile, seg = 64, { smooth = true, flip = false } = {}) {
  const pts = profile.map(p => new THREE.Vector2(p[0], p[1]));
  const curve = smooth ? new THREE.SplineCurve(pts) : null, n = smooth ? profile.length * 6 : profile.length - 1;
  const at = u => smooth ? curve.getPoint(u) : pts[Math.round(u * n)];

/* ───────────────────────── shaders ───────────────────────── */
const NOISE = /* glsl */`
float h21(vec2 p){ p=fract(p*vec2(123.34,456.21)); p+=dot(p,p+45.32); return fract(p.x*p.y); }
float vnoise(vec2 p){ vec2 i=floor(p),f=fract(p); f=f*f*(3.-2.*f);

`;
const JET_VERT = /* glsl */`
varying vec3 vJet; varying vec3 vN; varying vec3 vV; varying vec2 vUv0;
uniform mat4 uJetInv;
void main(){
  vec4 p=vec4(position,1.0); vec3 n=normal;

  #endif

  gl_Position=projectionMatrix*mv;

const JET_FRAG_HEAD = /* glsl */`
varying vec3 vJet; varying vec3 vN; varying vec3 vV; varying vec2 vUv0;
uniform float uXray,uTime,uI; uniform vec3 uCol,uGlow;
float rim(float p){ float d=dot(vN,vV)/max(length(vN)*length(vV),1e-6); return pow(clamp(1.0-abs(d),0.0,1.0),p); }
float cutGlow(float w){ return exp(-max(uXray-vJet.x,0.0)/w); }
`;
function jetShader(frag, uniforms = {}, opts = {}) {

    uniforms: { uJetInv: U.jetInv, uXray: U.xray, uTime: U.time, uGlow: U.glow, uI: { value: 1 }, uCol: { value: new THREE.Color(1, 1, 1) }, ...uniforms },

function ghost(sys, { base = 0.16, rimK = 1.1, col = null, u = null } = {}) {

    void main(){ if(vJet.x>uXray) discard;
      vec3 c=uCol*(uBase+uRim*rim(2.0))*uI + uGlow*cutGlow(0.12)*0.45*uI;
      gl_FragColor=vec4(c,1.0); }`,
    { uCol: { value: col ? new THREE.Color(col) : SYS[sys].col }, uI: u || (sys ? SYS[sys].u : cabinU), uBase: { value: base }, uRim: { value: rimK } });
}
// pipe or wire with travelling pulses
function flow(sys, len, { speed = 1.2, gap = 1.6, k = 1 } = {}) {

    void main(){ if(vJet.x>uXray) discard;

// semi-opaque volume (fuel) that keeps its colour over the glass
function solidGhost(sys, hex, alpha = 0.52) {
  return jetShader(NOISE + /* glsl */`uniform float uA;
    void main(){ if(vJet.x>uXray) discard; float k=clamp(uI,0.0,1.5);

      vec2 cf=abs(fract(g)-0.5)*2.0; float bay=(1.0-cf.x*cf.x)*(1.0-cf.y*cf.y);
      float sh=(0.62+0.6*bay+0.25*vnoise(vJet.xz*1.3+uTime*0.12))*(0.75+0.4*sin(vUv0.x*9.4+1.3)*sin(vUv0.x*3.1));

    { uCol: { value: new THREE.Color(hex) }, uI: SYS[sys].u, uA: { value: alpha } }, { blending: THREE.NormalBlending });
}
// thin structural lines
function lineMat(sys, k = 0.8, hex = null) {
  return jetShader(/* glsl */`uniform float uK; void main(){ if(vJet.x>uXray) discard; gl_FragColor=vec4(uCol*uK*clamp(uI,0.3,1.2),1.0); }`,

// glass skin shown where the x-ray has passed
function glassMat(front, gu = 40, gv = 24) {
  return jetShader(NOISE + /* glsl */`uniform float uFront; uniform vec2 uGrid;
    void main(){ if(vJet.x>uXray) discard;
      vec2 g=vUv0*uGrid; vec2 w=fwidth(g);

      float line=(1.0-smoothstep(0.35,0.95,l.x))*0.9+(1.0-smoothstep(0.3,0.85,l.y))*0.38;

      vec3 struc=vec3(0.22,0.60,1.0), navy=vec3(0.006,0.016,0.04);

    { uFront: { value: front ? 1 : 0 }, uGrid: { value: new THREE.Vector2(gu, gv) }, uI: SYS.structure.u },

}

// painted / metal surfaces: physically based, cut away where the x-ray has passed
const SKIN_KEYS = new Map();
// triplanar sampling: weights from a normal, then one texture fetch per axis
const TRI_GLSL = /* glsl */`
vec3 triW(vec3 n){ vec3 w=pow(abs(n),vec3(6.0)); return w/(w.x+w.y+w.z+1e-5); }
vec4 tri(sampler2D t, vec3 p, vec3 w, float s){ return texture2D(t,p.zy*s)*w.x+texture2D(t,p.xz*s)*w.y+texture2D(t,p.xy*s)*w.z; }
`;
// derivative bump (Mikkelsen): turns a per-pixel height in metres into a perturbed view-space normal
const BUMP_GLSL = /* glsl */`
if(gBumpS>0.0){ vec3 bp=-vViewPosition, dpx=dFdx(bp), dpy=dFdy(bp);
  vec3 r1=cross(dpy,normal), r2=cross(normal,dpx); float det=dot(dpx,r1)*faceDirection;
  vec3 gr=sign(det)*(dFdx(gBump)*r1+dFdy(gBump)*r2)*gBumpS;
  normal=normalize(abs(det)*normal-gr); }
`;
// bump: GLSL run after the normal is built; it may set gBump (height in metres) and gBumpS (strength). tex: extra sampler uniforms.
function skin({ color = 0xf3f2ee, rough = 0.3, metal = 0, cc = 1, ccr = 0.05, liv = '', map = null, side = THREE.FrontSide, cut = true, bump = '', tex = null } = {}) {
  const m = new THREE.MeshPhysicalMaterial({ color, roughness: rough, metalness: metal, clearcoat: cc, clearcoatRoughness: ccr, map, side });
  const key = liv + '|' + bump; if (!SKIN_KEYS.has(key)) SKIN_KEYS.set(key, SKIN_KEYS.size);
  m.onBeforeCompile = sh => {
    sh.uniforms.uJetInv = U.jetInv; sh.uniforms.uDoor = U.door; sh.uniforms.uXray = U.xray; sh.uniforms.uGlow = U.glow; sh.uniforms.uCabin = cabinFillU;
    let texHead = ''; if (tex) for (const k in tex) { sh.uniforms[k] = { value: tex[k] }; texHead += `uniform sampler2D ${k};\n`; }
    sh.vertexShader = 'varying vec3 vJet; varying vec2 vUv0; varying vec3 vJetN; varying vec3 vLoc; varying vec3 vLocN; uniform mat4 uJetInv;\n' + sh.vertexShader.replace('#include <begin_vertex>', `#include <begin_vertex>
      { vec4 jp=vec4(transformed,1.0); vec3 jn=objectNormal;
      #ifdef USE_INSTANCING
        jp=instanceMatrix*jp; jn=mat3(instanceMatrix)*jn;
      #endif
      vJet=(uJetInv*modelMatrix*jp).xyz; vJetN=normalize(mat3(uJetInv*modelMatrix)*jn); vLoc=transformed; vLocN=objectNormal; vUv0=uv; }`);
    sh.fragmentShader = 'varying vec3 vJet; varying vec2 vUv0; varying vec3 vJetN; varying vec3 vLoc; varying vec3 vLocN; uniform float uXray, uCabin, uDoor; uniform vec3 uGlow; uniform mat4 uJetInv; float gCc=1.0, gBump=0.0, gBumpS=0.0; vec3 gLm=vec3(0.95,1.0,1.1);\n' + texHead + NOISE + TRI_GLSL + sh.fragmentShader
      .replace('#include <normal_fragment_maps>', '#include <normal_fragment_maps>\n' + bump + BUMP_GLSL)
      .replace('#include <lights_physical_fragment>', '#include <lights_physical_fragment>\n#ifdef USE_CLEARCOAT\n material.clearcoat*=gCc;\n#endif')
      .replace('#include <clipping_planes_fragment>', '#include <clipping_planes_fragment>\n' + (cut ? 'if(vJet.x<uXray) discard;' : ''))
      .replace('#include <metalnessmap_fragment>', '#include <metalnessmap_fragment>\n' + liv)
      .replace('#include <emissivemap_fragment>', '#include <emissivemap_fragment>\n' + (cut ? 'totalEmissiveRadiance+=uGlow*exp(-max(vJet.x-uXray,0.0)/0.011)*4.0;' : ''));
  };
  m.customProgramCacheKey = () => 'skin' + SKIN_KEYS.get(key) + (cut ? 'c' : 'n');
  return m;
}
