/* hero j's place and burn at stage-local l. A swap at boundary b has three phases, each SW long: the next hero burns out of
   its alcove (b - 1.5 SW to b - .5 SW); on the dais one front climbs, the old hero burning away above it while the new one
   forms below it (b - .5 SW to b + .5 SW: never an empty dais, which is what a paused scroll used to show); then the old
   hero forms in the alcove the new one left. */
function heroState(j, l) {
  const f = featuredAt(l), h = SW / 2, bIn = j / 4, bOut = (j + 1) / 4;
  let uLo = -.2, uHi = 1.3;
  const dais = (j === 0 || l >= bIn - h) && (j === 3 || l < bOut + h);
  if (dais) {
    if (j > 0) { const e = range(bIn - h, bIn + h, l); if (e < 1) uHi = lerp(-.12, 1.3, easeIO(e)); }
    if (j < 3) { const e = range(bOut - h, bOut + h, l); if (e > 0) uLo = lerp(-.2, 1.12, easeIO(e)); }
  } else if (l < bIn) { const e = range(bIn - 3 * h, bIn - h, l); if (e > 0) uLo = lerp(-.2, 1.12, easeIO(e)); }
  else { const e = range(bOut + h, bOut + 3 * h, l); if (e < 1) uHi = lerp(-.12, 1.3, easeIO(e)); }
  return { f, segL: l * 4 - j, dais, slot: l < bIn ? j - 1 : j, uLo, uHi };
}

const camBase = { pos: new THREE.Vector3(), look: new THREE.Vector3() };
function stageCamera(l, dt) {
  const portrait = STG.cam.aspect < 1, seg = l * 4 - featuredAt(l);
  if (portrait) { camBase.pos.set(.05, .95, 6.1); camBase.look.set(.05, .92, 0); }
  else { camBase.pos.set(0, .34, 5.2); camBase.look.set(.18, 1.26, 0); }
  const orbit = Math.sin(seg * 6.2832) * -.05, push = (Math.sin(seg * Math.PI) - 1) * .2;   /* continuous across a swap (it snapped back at each boundary, unseen only while the dais stood empty) */
  const c = STG.cam, r = Math.hypot(camBase.pos.x, camBase.pos.z) - push, a = Math.atan2(camBase.pos.x, camBase.pos.z) + orbit;
  c.position.set(Math.sin(a) * r + SM.mx * .26, camBase.pos.y + SM.my * .07 + Math.sin(S.t * .5) * .015, Math.cos(a) * r);
  c.lookAt(camBase.look.x + SM.mx * .08, camBase.look.y + SM.my * .025, camBase.look.z);
  const fov = (portrait ? 44 + 14 * (1 - c.aspect) : 33) + clamp(Math.abs(S.vel) * .03, 0, 2);
  if (Math.abs(c.fov - fov) > .01) { c.fov = fov; c.updateProjectionMatrix(); }
}

function idleHero(H, t, dt, active) {
  const R = H.rig; if (!R) return;
  H.turn.getWorldQuaternion(_qc); _qci.copy(_qc).invert();
  for (const b of R.all) b.quaternion.copy(b.userData.rest);
  const br = Math.sin(t * 1.3 + H.ph), sw = Math.sin(t * .41 + H.ph * 2.3), sw2 = Math.sin(t * .63 + H.ph);
  turnBone(R.hips, 0, sw * .02, sw * .012);
  R.spine.forEach((b, k) => turnBone(b, -br * .012 + (k === 0 ? sw2 * .006 : 0), -sw * .012, -sw * .008));
  /* head follows the cursor (or drifts when idle), within a comfortable cone */
  let ty = 0, tx = 0;
  if (R.head) {
    R.head.getWorldPosition(_v1);
    _v2.set(SM.tx / innerWidth * 2 - 1, -(SM.ty / innerHeight * 2 - 1), .5).unproject(STG.cam).sub(STG.cam.position).normalize();
    const dist = STG.cam.position.distanceTo(_v1); _v2.multiplyScalar(dist * .85).add(STG.cam.position);
    _v2.sub(_v1).applyQuaternion(_qci);
    ty = clamp(Math.atan2(_v2.x, _v2.z), -.7, .7) * (active ? 1 : .5); tx = clamp(-Math.atan2(_v2.y, Math.hypot(_v2.x, _v2.z)), -.35, .3) * (active ? 1 : .5);
  }
  const k = 1 - Math.exp(-dt * 3.2);
  H.look.x = lerp(H.look.x, tx, k); H.look.y = lerp(H.look.y, ty, k);
  turnBone(R.neck, H.look.x * .35, H.look.y * .38, 0);
  turnBone(R.head, H.look.x * .55 + br * .006, H.look.y * .55, 0);
  const P = H.def.pose || {};
  turnBone(R.armL, 0, 0, br * .012 + sw2 * .01 + (P.armL || 0));
  turnBone(R.armR, 0, 0, -br * .012 - sw2 * .01 + (P.armR || 0));
  if (P.legs) { turnBone(R.legL, 0, 0, P.legs); turnBone(R.legR, 0, 0, -P.legs); }
  if (P.foreR) turnBone(R.foreR, 0, 0, P.foreR);
  if (P.shield && R.handL) R.handL.scale.setScalar(P.shield);
}

function updateStage(p, dt) {
  const t = S.t, l = stageLocal(p);
  PLATE.u.uPRes.value = finalPass.uniforms.uRes.value;
  stageCamera(l, dt);
  const f = featuredAt(l);
  if (!STG.drag) { STG.spinV *= Math.exp(-dt * 2.4); STG.spin += STG.spinV * dt; STG.spin *= Math.exp(-dt * .9); }
  let swap = 0;
  STG.heroes.forEach((H, j) => {
    if (!H) return;
    const s = heroState(j, l);
    H.B.u.uLo.value = s.uLo; H.B.u.uHi.value = s.uHi;
    H.pivot.visible = s.uLo < 1.1 && s.uHi > -.1;
    if (s.dais) {
      H.pivot.position.set(0, DAIS.h - (H.def.sink || 0), 0);   /* (the Penitent's spread stance lifted his heels clear of the dais) */
      H.pivot.rotation.y = H.def.yaw + (s.segL - .5) * .55 + STG.spin;
      H.pivot.scale.setScalar(1);
      H.B.u.uLift.value = 0;
    } else {
      const [x, z, ph] = SLOTS[s.slot];
      H.pivot.position.set(x, ph, z); H.pivot.rotation.y = -.3 + Math.sin(t * .2 + j) * .03;
      H.pivot.scale.setScalar(H.def.slotScale || 1);
      H.B.u.uLift.value = 0;
    }
    if (s.dais) swap = Math.max(swap, 1 - Math.abs(s.uLo - .5) * 2, 1 - Math.abs(s.uHi - .55) * 1.6);   /* (only the dais's own swap flares: a hero forming in an alcove washed the dais hero gold) */
    const glowK = clamp((s.uHi - .95) / .3) * clamp(1 - (s.uLo + .15) / .35);
    for (const o of H.spots) { if (o.isSprite) o.material.opacity = glowK; else o.material.uniforms.uInt.value = o.userData.base * glowK; }
    idleHero(H, t + j * 3.1, dt, s.dais);
  });
  const fl = .78 + .14 * Math.sin(t * 13.1) + .08 * Math.sin(t * 27.3 + 1.3);
  const L = STG.L, on = STG.mix;
  L.key.intensity = 9 * on; L.rimL.intensity = 20 * on * (.85 + .15 * fl); L.steel.intensity = 38 * on; L.rimR.intensity = 22 * on; L.front.intensity = 2.6 * on; L.fill.intensity = 60 * on; L.back.intensity = 40 * on; L.nave1.intensity = 22 * on * (.9 + .1 * fl); L.nave2.intensity = 26 * on; L.low.intensity = 1.2 * on * fl; L.flank.intensity = 2.2 * on;
  /* each oath has its own light from behind: ember, violet, a cold moon, grave-green (one amber wash made the four alike) */
  STG.rimC ||= ['#ff5a28', '#a45cff', '#c9d6ff', '#a8e060'].map(c => new THREE.Color(c));
  L.rimR.color.lerp(STG.rimC[f], 1 - Math.exp(-dt * 3)); L.rimR.intensity *= f === 0 ? 1.4 : 3.2;
  L.flare.intensity = 6.5 * clamp(swap) * fl;
  STG.fires.forEach(F => { F.L.intensity = F.base * on * (.72 + .18 * Math.sin(t * 11 + F.seed) + .1 * Math.sin(t * 23 + F.seed * 3)); });
  STG.runeMat.emissiveIntensity = (2.2 + 3 * clamp(swap)) * on;
  STG.embers.material.uniforms.uCam.value.copy(STG.cam.position); STG.ash.material.uniforms.uCam.value.copy(STG.cam.position);
  STG.embers.material.uniforms.uBoost.value = .3 + clamp(swap) * .8;
  if (f !== STG.f) { STG.f = f; setOath(f, SHOT); }
}

/* =========================================================

   own target (figures, props and UI painted out), projected from the chapter's rest camera onto a far
   backdrop and, where there is one, the floor. In front of it live the parts that move: sparks, the
   breathing fire in the painting, and the real props (the burning logo, the Ashen Crown). The camera
   drifts within a set with the scroll, and sets cross through the same ember burn as the Hall.
   ?legacy shows the old modelled world instead.

const SET_D = 40, SET_FOV = 40, SET_ASP = 16 / 9;
const SET_CAM0 = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(SET_FOV, SET_ASP, .1, 200);   /* every plate was painted from this pose */
SET_CAM0.updateMatrixWorld();

/* story-p ranges; sets overlap where they burn into each other */
const SET_DEFS = [
  ...(Q.has('oldgate') ? [{ k: 'gate', a: -1, b: .205, floor: .78, phoneX: .5 }, { k: 'realm', a: .165, b: .48, phoneX: .62 }] : []),   /* the journey (47) replaces these */
  { k: 'best', a: .48, b: .785, phoneX: .49 },
  { k: 'relic', a: .748, b: .93, floor: .8, phoneX: .42 },
  { k: 'hunt', a: .895, b: 9, phoneX: .535 }   /* a phone keeps more of the cathedral */

const SETS = {};
/* the crown's rest pose: plate point (at 7 m), Euler XYZ, scale, extra y-scale; fitted to the target's silhouette by tools/crownfit.py */
const CROWN_POSE = Q.has('cpose') ? Q.get('cpose').split(',').map(Number) : [.378, .3277, .1243, 4.6864, .0201, 2.3501, 1.152];
/* albedo multiplier, albedo saturation, environment strength, fire-light on the silhouette */
const [CR_R, CR_G, CR_B, CROWN_SAT, CROWN_ENV, CROWN_FRES, CROWN_ROUGH = .8, CROWN_NRM = 1] = Q.has('ctune') ? Q.get('ctune').split(',').map(Number) : [.5, .45, .42, .5, 1.6, 1.5, 1, 2.5];
const CROWN_TINT = [CR_R, CR_G, CR_B];
/* the fire inside: tongue height, width and brightness; the glow on the inner wall; the haze sheet's height, glow and filaments */
const [CF_H, CF_W, CF_I, CROWN_HOT, HZ0, HZ1, HZ2, CF_C = .12] = Q.has('cfire') ? Q.get('cfire').split(',').map(Number) : [.11, .045, .9, .05, .26, .6, 1.8, .8], HZ = [HZ0, HZ1, HZ2];
const [CL_KEY, CL_RIM, CL_FRONT] = Q.has('clight') ? Q.get('clight').split(',').map(Number) : [155, 54, 45];   /* key, back rim and a front fill on the band */
const CF_SHEET = Q.has('csheet') ? +Q.get('csheet') : .6, CSPIN = Q.has('cspin') ? +Q.get('cspin') : 0;   /* the rim sheet's strength against the tongues; ?cspin=rad turns the crown in a still */
const CROWN_BLADE = Q.has('cblade') ? +Q.get('cblade') : .88;   /* blade length against the band, measured on the target's silhouette */
const SET_NOW = { A: null, B: null, mix: 0 };

/* a point on the rest camera's view ray through plate pixel (fx, fy), dist metres away */
function setPoint(fx, fy, dist = SET_D) {
  const v = new THREE.Vector3(fx * 2 - 1, -(fy * 2 - 1), .5).unproject(SET_CAM0).normalize();
  return v.multiplyScalar(dist / -v.z);   /* dist is depth along -Z, so it lands on the backdrop plane */
}

function plateMat(tex, hotK) {
  return new THREE.ShaderMaterial({ fog: false,
    uniforms: { uTime: U.uTime, tPlate: { value: tex }, uPlatePV: { value: SET_PV }, uPSat: PLATE.u.uPSat, uPVig: PLATE.u.uPVig, uPExp: PLATE.u.uPExp, uPRes: PLATE.u.uPRes, uHotK: hotK },
    vertexShader: /* glsl */`varying vec3 vWP; void main(){ vec4 w = modelMatrix * vec4(position, 1.); vWP = w.xyz; gl_Position = projectionMatrix * viewMatrix * w; }`,
    fragmentShader: /* glsl */`${GLSL_PLATE} varying vec3 vWP; void main(){ gl_FragColor = vec4(plateAt(vWP).rgb, 1.); }` });
}

function buildSet(def, tex) {
  const scene = new THREE.Scene(); scene.background = new THREE.Color('#050302');
  const cam = def.k === 'gate' ? camera : new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(SET_FOV, innerWidth / innerHeight, .1, 300);
  scene.add(cam);
  const hotK = { value: 1 }, mat = plateMat(tex, hotK);
  const th = Math.tan(THREE.MathUtils.degToRad(SET_FOV / 2)), hh = SET_D * th * 1.7;
  const back = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(hh * 2 * 2.6, hh * 2), mat); back.position.z = -SET_D; scene.add(back);
  if (def.floor) {   /* the floor meets the backdrop on the painting's floor line */
    const y = -(def.floor - .5) * 2 * th * SET_D;
    const f = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(400, SET_D + 4), mat); f.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2; f.position.set(0, y, -SET_D / 2 + 2); scene.add(f);
  }
  const embers = particleField(LOW ? 180 : 420, { seed: 50 + def.k.length, box: [34, 16, 34], size: 26, y0: -6, scene });
  const S0 = { def, scene, cam, hotK, embers, plumes: [], extra: {}, back };
  SETS[def.k] = S0;
  return S0;
}

/* the Ashen Crown: Tripo's model when it is there, the code-built one otherwise */
function fetchCrown() {
  const loader = new GLTFLoader(), draco = new DRACOLoader();
  draco.setDecoderPath('https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.170.0/examples/jsm/libs/draco/gltf/'); loader.setDRACOLoader(draco);

}
async function buildRelicCrown(set, gltf) {   /* gltf: the model as fetchCrown() left it (it comes with the Relic's own load) */

    const fit = () => { model.updateMatrixWorld(true);
      const box = new THREE.Box3().setFromObject(model, true), s = 1 / (box.max.y - box.min.y), c = box.getCenter(new THREE.Vector3());
      model.scale.multiplyScalar(s); model.position.multiplyScalar(s).sub(c.multiplyScalar(s)); model.updateMatrixWorld(true); };

    R.pivot.add(model); R.model = model; R.unit = 1;
    const ring = R.ring = crownRing(model), uRing = { value: new THREE.Vector4(ring.cx, ring.cz, ring.yBot, ring.yTop) };
    model.traverse(o => {
      if (!o.isMesh) return; const m = o.material, toPivot = { value: o.matrixWorld.clone() };   /* the pivot is still at identity */
      m.envMap = STG.heroEnv; m.envMapIntensity = CROWN_ENV; m.color.setRGB(...CROWN_TINT); m.metalness = 1; m.roughness = CROWN_ROUGH; m.normalScale.setScalar(CROWN_NRM); if (m.map) m.map.anisotropy = 8;
      /* the gems smoulder, the lower rim burns and the fire inside lights the silhouette: emissive from the albedo's crimson, from height and from the view angle */
      m.onBeforeCompile = sh => {
        sh.uniforms.uTime = U.uTime; sh.uniforms.uRing = uRing; sh.uniforms.uToPivot = toPivot;
        sh.vertexShader = sh.vertexShader.replace('#include <common>', '#include <common>\nvarying vec3 vOP; varying vec3 vON; uniform mat4 uToPivot;').replace('#include <begin_vertex>', '#include <begin_vertex>\nvOP = (uToPivot * vec4(position, 1.)).xyz; vON = mat3(uToPivot) * objectNormal;');
        sh.fragmentShader = sh.fragmentShader.replace('#include <common>', `#include <common>
          varying vec3 vOP; varying vec3 vON; uniform float uTime; uniform vec4 uRing; ${GLSL_NOISE}`)
          .replace('#include <map_fragment>', `#include <map_fragment>
          diffuseColor.rgb = mix(vec3(dot(diffuseColor.rgb, vec3(.2126, .7152, .0722))), diffuseColor.rgb, ${CROWN_SAT.toFixed(3)});
          vec3 albG = texture2D(map, vMapUv).rgb; float gemK = smoothstep(2.2, 3.2, albG.r / max(albG.g, .004)) * smoothstep(.05, .14, albG.r);   /* the gems: crimson in the painted albedo */`)

          .replace('#include <roughnessmap_fragment>', '#include <roughnessmap_fragment>\n roughnessFactor = mix(roughnessFactor, .07, gemK);')
          .replace('#include <metalnessmap_fragment>', '#include <metalnessmap_fragment>\n metalnessFactor = mix(metalnessFactor, .0, gemK);')
          .replace('#include <emissivemap_fragment>', `#include <emissivemap_fragment>
          float gem = gemK;
          /* facets: the stone's face is broken into planes (cells of its own position), each with its own tilt; a facet turned toward the eye flashes, the rest sit deep red */
          vec3 fc = floor(vOP * 46.), fr3 = fract(vOP * 46.) - .5;
          vec3 fN = normalize(normal + (vec3(hash12(fc.xy + fc.z * 3.1), hash12(fc.yz + fc.x * 5.7), hash12(fc.zx + fc.y * 7.3)) - .5) * .9);
          float fV = clamp(dot(fN, normalize(vViewPosition)), 0., 1.);

  R.under = new THREE.PointLight('#ff6a20', 0, 1.5, 2); R.under.position.set(0, -.75, .5); R.pivot.add(R.under);
  R.fill = new THREE.HemisphereLight(new THREE.Color('#5a3a28'), new THREE.Color('#120806'), .3); sc.add(R.fill);

}

/* Tripo leaves the crown tipped a few degrees: fit a plane through the lowest point in each sector of the bottom edge
   (dropping thorns that hang below it) and turn the model so that plane is level */
function crownLevel(model) {
  const v = new THREE.Vector3(), B = 48, lo = Array.from({ length: B }, () => [0, 9, 0]);
  const box = new THREE.Box3().setFromObject(model, true), c = box.getCenter(new THREE.Vector3()), r0 = (box.max.x - box.min.x) * .3;

/* the band in pivot space: its axis, bottom and top heights and radii. The band is where the mesh reaches
   the outer radius all the way round; above it only the blades do */
function crownRing(model) {
  model.updateMatrixWorld(true);

    for (let i = 0; i < a.count; i += 3) { v.fromBufferAttribute(a, i).applyMatrix4(o.matrixWorld); P.push(v.x, v.y, v.z); } });
  const n = P.length / 3; let y0 = Infinity, y1 = -Infinity, x0 = Infinity, x1 = -Infinity, z0 = Infinity, z1 = -Infinity;

/* the band's own inner rim, all the way round. The model is hand-made: its opening is neither round nor level (the inner wall
   stands .35 to .48 from the axis, and its lip dips by .12 on one side), so a fire on a level circle stood clear of the wall in
   places and cut through it in others. Per sector: the inner wall's radius in the band's middle, the highest point of that wall

/* the fire's glow rising over the back of the band: a sheet facing the camera just behind the far wall, hottest at
   the rim and crackling with thin filaments (ridged noise). The wall hides its lower part, so the inside stays soot */
function crownHaze(parent, ring) {
  const g = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(1, 1).translate(0, .5, 0);
  const m = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({ transparent: true, depthWrite: false, blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending, fog: false,
    uniforms: { uTime: U.uTime, uK: { value: 0 }, uC: { value: new THREE.Vector4(ring.cx, ring.yTop - .03, ring.cz, ring.rTop) } },
    vertexShader: /* glsl */`uniform vec4 uC; varying vec2 vUv;

/* the rest pose plus drift: everything is a function of p; the mouse adds a little parallax and a push that
   keeps the painting's edges out of frame */
const _sv = new THREE.Vector3();
function poseSet(S0, p, par) {
  const k = S0.def.k, c = S0.cam;

  else if (k === 'best') {
    if (S0.layered) {   /* one continuous pull-back and descent through the whole chapter: the near crags rise and close in from the
                           corners as the far planes settle, so the depth keeps working while the text is up */
      const q = range(.55, .785, p), e = .4 * easeIO(q) + .6 * q;
      if (!REDUCED) { z = -3.5 + 5.5 * e; y = 1.2 - 2.4 * q; S0.zoom = .9 + .1 * easeIO(q); }   /* and a slow zoom-out, so the pull-back reads at every depth */

/* the eclipse loop: webm or mp4, 720p on desktop, 480p on phones; it only loads as the chapter nears and only plays while it is on screen */
function bestVideos() {
  if (REDUCED) return;
  const small = LOW || Math.min(innerWidth, innerHeight) < 700, can = document.createElement('video').canPlayType('video/webm; codecs="vp9"');
  const v = document.createElement('video');
  Object.assign(v, { muted: true, loop: true, playsInline: true, preload: 'none', crossOrigin: 'anonymous' });
  v.setAttribute('muted', ''); v.setAttribute('playsinline', '');
  v.dataset.src = `assets/best/ecl${small ? '_480' : '_720'}.${can ? 'webm' : 'mp4'}?v=${BEST.meta.v}`;
  const t = new THREE.VideoTexture(v); t.colorSpace = THREE.NoColorSpace; t.minFilter = THREE.LinearFilter; t.generateMipmaps = false;
  BEST.vid.ecl = { v, t, live: false };
  /* the corona's brightness, read off the loop a few times a second, drives the rim light on Vael */
  BEST.probe = mkCanvas(12, 12); BEST.probeX = BEST.probe.getContext('2d', { willReadFrequently: true });
}

let _bestProbeT = 0;
function updateBest(p, dt, on) {
  if (!BEST.ready) return;
  const u = BEST.mat.uniforms;
  for (const k of ['ecl']) {
    const V = BEST.vid[k]; if (!V) continue;
    if (!V.v._want && p > .4) { setSrc(V.v, V.v.dataset.src); V.v.preload = 'auto'; }
    const want = on && !document.hidden;
    if (want && V.v.paused && V.v.src) V.v.play().catch(() => {});
    if (!want && !V.v.paused) V.v.pause();
    const ok = V.v.readyState >= 2 && !V.v.paused;
    if (ok && !V.live) { V.live = true; u.tVidE.value = V.t; }
    BEST.vidK[k] = clamp(BEST.vidK[k] + (ok ? dt : -dt) * 1.5, 0, 1);   /* fade the loop in over the painted still: they match, so this only hides a stall */
  }
  u.uVidK.value = BEST.vidK.ecl;
  /* Vael: a slow, heavy breath (6.4 s), the head swaying and nodding on longer periods, the eyes swelling with the breath and flaring now and then */
  const t = S.t, br0 = .5 - .5 * Math.cos(t * 6.2832 / 6.4), br = br0 * br0 * (3 - 2 * br0);
  const hb = (t % 2.3) / 2.3, beat = Math.exp(-Math.pow((hb - .08) / .045, 2)) + .7 * Math.exp(-Math.pow((hb - .24) / .05, 2));   /* lub-dub */
  u.uHeart.value.z = REDUCED ? .35 : .35 + .65 * beat;
  u.uAnim.value.set(br, .001 * Math.sin(t * 6.2832 / 13.7), .0007 * Math.sin(t * 6.2832 / 9.1 + 1.3), REDUCED ? 0 : .12 + .22 * br + .5 * Math.pow(Math.max(0, Math.sin(t * 6.2832 / 17.3)), 8));
  /* corona brightness → rim light */
  const E = BEST.vid.ecl;
  if (E?.live && on && (_bestProbeT += dt) > .12) {
    _bestProbeT = 0;
    const v = E.v, b = BEST.meta.vbox.ecl, e = BEST.meta.ecl, vw = v.videoWidth, vh = v.videoHeight;
    const cx = (e.cx - b.x) / b.w * vw, cy = (e.cy - b.y) / b.h * vh, r = e.r / b.h * vh * 1.6;
    BEST.probeX.drawImage(v, cx - r, cy - r, r * 2, r * 2, 0, 0, 12, 12);
    const px = BEST.probeX.getImageData(0, 0, 12, 12).data; let s = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < px.length; i += 4) s += px[i] * .3 + px[i + 1] * .6 + px[i + 2] * .1;
    BEST.eclBase = BEST.eclBase ? lerp(BEST.eclBase, s, .02) : s;
    BEST.eclB = clamp(s / BEST.eclBase, .8, 1.25);
  }
  u.uEclB.value = lerp(u.uEclB.value, BEST.vidK.ecl > 0 ? BEST.eclB : 1, 1 - Math.exp(-dt * 6));
  /* the torch: where the cursor is, in drawing-buffer pixels */
  const res = PLATE.u.uPRes.value, k = !(MOUSE.moved || BEST.tourOn) ? 0 : .6 * (REDUCED ? 1 : .86 + .14 * Math.sin(S.t * 13.1));   /* reduced motion keeps the torch (the pointer's own, so the carvings can still be read) without its flicker */
  u.uTorch.value.set(SM.tx / innerWidth * res.x, (1 - SM.ty / innerHeight) * res.y, k);
  BEST.hdr ||= document.getElementById('hdr');
  u.uNav.value = (BEST.hdr.getBoundingClientRect().bottom + 6) / innerHeight * res.y;
  const N = SETS.best.near; if (N) { N.material.uniforms.uCam.value.copy(SETS.best.cam.position); N.material.uniforms.uBoost.value = .55; N.material.uniforms.uWind.value = clamp(S.vel * .012, -.6, .6); }
}

/* =========================================================

   eclipse, the demon, the cathedral, and the burning city in front. Each is projected from the rest camera onto its own
   plane, so at rest they rebuild the painting exactly; as the camera pushes in and follows the pointer each moves at its own
   depth (the embers in front are a sixth). Two generated loops play inside their masks: the eclipse's corona is blended into
   its ring; the demon's loop adds only its change from its own median frame to the painted demon, so the painting stays exact
   and the loop brings the breath, the pulse in the cracks and the eyes. Smoke parts as the chapter opens.
   ?flathunt keeps the single plate.

const HUNT = {
  layered: !Q.has('flathunt'), ready: false, meta: null, mat: null, vid: {}, vidK: { ecl: 0, dem: 0 }, eclB: 1, eclBase: 0,
  /* plane depths (m), chosen so the pointer moves the sky ~2 px, the eclipse ~2-3, the demon ~7-8, the cathedral ~16 and the
     city ~22 (the camera's sideways reach is set from the city's depth in poseSet); the push separates them the same way */
  depth: { sky: 650, ecl: 500, demon: 160, cath: 70, city: 52 },
  eyes: [.4802, .389, .5211, .391],   /* in the extended painting (Vael's head, tools/layers/hunt_head.py; the old skull's loop is off: assets/hunt/hunt.json videos.dem) */
  z0: 4.5, z1: -1.5,   /* the push: from a little behind the painting's own camera to a little past it */
  fovK: 1., pitch: .02,
  reach: 22   /* px the city moves at the pointer's full reach */

  const box = n => { const r = meta.vbox[n]; return new THREE.Vector4(r.x, r.y, r.w, r.h); };

    tSky: { value: tex[0] }, tEcl: { value: tex[1] }, tDem: { value: tex[2] }, tCath: { value: tex[3] }, tCity: { value: tex[4] },
    rSky: { value: R('sky') }, rEcl: { value: R('ecl') }, rDem: { value: R('demon') }, rCath: { value: R('cath') }, rCity: { value: R('city') },

function updateHunt(p, dt, on) {

    ENTRY.lit = 1; document.body.classList.add('bch-soot');

    if (now - GOV.up < 6000 && GOV.prev) GOV.ceil[zone] = { v: GOV.prev, t: now };   /* the last climb did not hold here */
    if (setDPR(Math.max(DPR * .76, DPR * Math.sqrt(17 / avg)), now)) GOV.hold = now + 1300;
    GOV.mem[zone] = DPR;
  } else if (avg < 17.6 && now - GOV.change > 2600) {
    const top = Math.min(DPR_CAP, GOV.ceil[zone]?.v ?? DPR_CAP);
    GOV.mem[zone] = DPR;
    if (DPR < top - .04) { GOV.prev = DPR; if (setDPR(Math.min(top, DPR * 1.12), now)) { GOV.up = now; GOV.hold = now + 1600; } }

}
function loop(now) {
  govern(now, now - last);
  const dt = Math.min(.05, (now - last) / 1000); last = now;
  S.t = FREEZE ?? S.t + dt; U.uTime.value = S.t;
  if (lenis) { lenis.raf(now); if (!SHOT && lenis.limit > 0) bgHold(); S.p = lenis.limit > 0 ? warp(clamp(lenis.scroll / lenis.limit)) : 0; S.vel = lerp(S.vel, lenis.velocity || 0, .2); }
  update(S.p, dt);
  composer.render();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}

function resize() {
  const w = innerWidth, h = innerHeight;
  camera.aspect = w / h; camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
  STG.cam.aspect = w / h; STG.cam.updateProjectionMatrix();
  for (const k in SETS) { const c = SETS[k].cam; if (c !== camera) { c.aspect = w / h; c.updateProjectionMatrix(); } SETS[k].embers.material.uniforms.uPix.value = DPR * h / 900; }
  renderer.setSize(w, h, false); composer?.setSize(w, h);
  finalPass?.uniforms.uRes.value.set(w * DPR, h * DPR); if (finalPass) finalPass.uniforms.uSharp.value = sharpFor(DPR);
  const pix = DPR * h / 900;
  if (W.embers) { W.embers.material.uniforms.uPix.value = pix; W.ash.material.uniforms.uPix.value = pix; W.logo.pm.uniforms.uPix.value = pix; }
  if (STG.plumes) STG.plumes.forEach(o => o.material.uniforms.uPix.value = pix);
  if (STG.embers) { STG.embers.material.uniforms.uPix.value = pix; STG.ash.material.uniforms.uPix.value = pix; STG.heroes.forEach(H => H && (H.pts.material.uniforms.uPix.value = pix)); }
  /* (the fires, the sets' plumes and near sparks were sized once when built: with a governed ratio they follow it too) */
  if (typeof FIRE !== 'undefined' && FIRE.u?.uPix) FIRE.u.uPix.value = pix;
  for (const k in SETS) { const s = SETS[k]; for (const o of [s.near, ...(s.plumes || [])]) if (o?.material?.uniforms?.uPix) o.material.uniforms.uPix.value = pix; }
}
addEventListener('resize', () => { resize(); lenis?.resize(); FOOT.pad = undefined; FOOT.px = -1; });

/* capture / test hooks */
window.__ember = {
  S, CH, STG, SETS, SET_NOW, BCH, BG, gsap, THREE, renderer, JR, WM, jFitCam, PRE, ENTRY, go: () => preGo(), get p() { return S.p; }, get camera() { return camera; }, PC3, BEST, HUNT, INTRO, get introPass() { return introPass; }, get composer() { return composer; }, get bloom() { return bloom; }, JSMOKE, GOV, get dpr() { return DPR; }, setDPR,
  set(p) { if (lenis) lenis.scrollTo(unwarp(p) * lenis.limit, { immediate: true }); S.p = p; },
  ready: () => S.ready
};

boot().catch(e => { __errs.push(String(e && e.stack || e)); console.error(e); });
